We use data parallelism to shard the training batch across devices. We use expert parallelism to partition experts across devices; for example, placing experts 1 and 2 on device 1, experts 3 and 4 on device 2, and so on. Model parallelism is a third axis along which model weights (matrices) can be sharded across devices; for example, expert 1 is split across devices 1 and 2, expert 2 is split across devices 3 and 4, and so on. Model parallelism is beneficial for scaling to larger model sizes. See also [\(Fedus](#page-10-4) [et al., 2022\)](#page-10-4) for a more detailed discussion of these three parallelization strategies. # B ABLATIONS AND ADDITIONAL EXPERIMENTS In this section, we present results for a number of model ablations that try to identify good choices for the main upcycling algorithm decisions. As mentioned in the main text, unless stated otherwise, vision ablations use a B/16 sparse model with 32 experts, C = 1 and 6 MoE layers placed in the last few block of the model. The dense checkpoint was trained for 14 epochs, and we train for an additional 7 epochs (up to a total of 21 epochs). Note that, for C = 1, comparing performance on a per step basis is a reasonably close approximation of a comparison on a per train time basis. For our language ablations, our default configuration is unchanged: we use a Base model with 32 experts, C = 2 and 6 MoE layers interspersed throughout the model. We train for between 0.5 million and 1 million extra steps. # B.1 ROUTER TYPE While our default upcycling recipe uses Expert Choice routing [Zhou et al.](#page-13-1) [\(2022\)](#page-13-1) (in the encoder), the same recipe can be applied to other routing mechanisms. Here, we compare with Top-K routing [Shazeer et al.](#page-12-4) [\(2017\)](#page-12-4), which is a very popular alternative. Table [2](#page-17-2) shows that, for vision, sparse upcycling with Top-K routing works comparably well to Expert Choice, on a per step basis, provided we also use Batch Priority Routing (BPR) [\(Riquelme et al., 2021\)](#page-11-6). BPR sorts tokens according to a model confidence proxy so that –when experts are full– high confidence tokens are given priority. We suspect this may be helpful right at the beginning, when applying the upcycling, to avoid discarding important tokens. Expert Choice avoids this problem by design, as experts are always balanced and select the most 'relevant' tokens. Table 2: Sparse Upcycling on L/32 vision models with Expert Choice and Top-K routing (also known as Top-K). K refers to the number of selected experts per token, while C refers to the capacity factor. Notice that with Expert Choice routing, each token chooses C experts on average. The initial dense checkpoint was trained for 7 epochs. Note that these comparison are on a per-step basis, and that Expert Choice upcycled models are actually slightly faster than Top-K models; see Figure 8. | Model | Capacity | From | Extra Epochs | Val Prec@1 | ImageNet 10shot | |---------------|----------|---------|--------------|------------|-----------------| | Dense | _ | Dense | 7 | 49.60 | 73.59 | | Expert Choice | C = 1 | Dense | 7 | 51.91 | 74.04 | | Top-K | K = 1 | Dense | 7 | 51.51 | 74.40 | | Expert Choice | C = 2 | Dense | 7 | 52.80 | 74.83 | | Top-K | K = 2 | Dense | 7 | 52.88 | 74.91 | | Expert Choice | C = 1 | Scratch | 7 | 50.42 | 72.95 | | Expert Choice | C = 2 | Scratch | 7 | 51.28 | 74.01 | | Expert Choice | C = 1 | Scratch | 14 | 54.84 | 75.02 | | Expert Choice | C = 2 | Scratch | 14 | 55.46 | 75.75 | ![](_page_17_Figure_3.jpeg) Figure 8: Comparison of Expert Choice, Top-2 and Switch (Top-1) routing mechanisms for a Base upcycled language model. For language, similar ablations (Figure 8) shows that Expert Choice routing outperforms both Top-2 routing (with BPR) and switch (Top-1) routing, on a train time basis. # B.2 ROUTER CAPACITY FACTOR Sparsifying the dense model increases the model capacity (number of parameters). However, if the capacity factor C=1, then the FLOPS is very similar to the original, dense model (modulo the small routing costs). We can increase the per-token compute by increasing C. Figure 9 investigates this, and shows our results for vision (left and center panels) and language (right panel). For vision, we see that extreme values (C=1 and C=5) underperform intermediate values (C=2 and C=3) that offer better trade-offs. For language, the trend is even stronger: A capacity factor of C=2 stands out as the best option on a per compute basis. #### B.3 Number of experts Adding more experts increases the number of model parameters and, up to a point, the quality of the model. Given that the number of tokens each expert processes is inversely proportional to the number of experts (see Section 2.1), adding more experts usually only leads to very modest computational (and wall time) overheads. However, for a very large number of experts, the upcycled model may experience a larger initial quality drop relative to the baseline dense model. ![](_page_18_Figure_1.jpeg) Figure 9: Pretraining performance achieved by upcycling using different capacity factors, for a B/16 (left and center panels, vision tasks) and a Base T5 model (right plot, text task). The x-axis shows the extra pretraining time (TPU-core-days), with respect to the total time needed to train the original dense checkpoint. Although using a bigger capacity factors can result in an absolute better performance when runtime is disregarded (e.g. see the vision results), for a given fixed compute budget, it is usually better to use a capacity factor of around 2.0. ![](_page_18_Figure_3.jpeg) Figure 10: Pretraining performance achieved by the upcycling method on the vision tasks, using different number of experts per MoE layer (two left plots, with a total number of 6 MoE layers), and a different number of MoE layers (two right plots, with a total number of 32 experts; all MoE layers are placed at the top Transformer blocks). The x-axis shows the extra pretraining time (TPU-core-days), with respect to the total time needed to train the original dense checkpoint. Figure 10 (two left panels) shows the results of a vision experiment with 6 MoE layers with a number of experts ranging from 2 to 128. For a fixed amount of compute (value in the x-axis), we see that more experts is generally better for this B/16 model. Figure 11 shows the final metric values both for upstream (JFT precision at 1) and downstream (ImageNet 10-shot) with respect to the number of experts. We see steady improvements upstream, and –at some point– diminishing returns downstream. # B.4 Number of MoE layers Another key decision is how many layers to sparsify. More layers leads to higher model capacity, while –especially for higher C– it introduces significant extra wall time overhead. We ablate this for vision models, as shown in Figure 10 (two right panels). For a B/16 model with 12 blocks, we train upcycled versions with an increasing number of MoE layers; MoE layers are consecutive and start from the last layer. For example, the model labeled as '5' corresponds to a model where the last 5 MLP layers are sparsified, and so on. Thus, model '1' only has one MoE layer (the last one) and it is the computationally cheapest in terms of wall time. We do not include a model where all layers are sparsified (would correspond to '12') as we found that sparsifying the very first block tends to be problematic. We see in Figure 10 (two right panels) that more MoE layers is not always better even on a per step basis; see Figure 12 for both upstream and downstream metrics. Looking at a fixed value of the x-axis in Figure 10 (right panels), we conclude that something between Last-5 and Last-6 (40-50% of layers sparsified) offers the most attractive trade-off in this case. ![](_page_19_Figure_1.jpeg) Figure 11: Final upstream and downstream performance for upcycled B/16 vision models with different number of experts per MoE layer. The number of MoE layers is fixed at 6. The upcycled model is trained for an additional 7 epochs (from 14 to 21) relative to the original dense model. The dashed horizontal lines show the performance of the dense model when trained for an additional 7 epochs. ![](_page_19_Figure_3.jpeg) Figure 12: Performance as a function of the number of MoE layers for upcycled B/16 models (C=1) trained for 7 additional epochs on JFT, starting from a dense checkpoint originally trained for 14 epochs. MoE layers are consecutively placed starting from the last block. We train models ranging from 1 MoE layer (Last-1) to 11 MoE layers (Last-11) – i.e. all but the very first. The dashed horizontal lines show the performance of the dense model when trained for an additional 7 epochs. #### **B.5** EXPERT INITIALIZATION The standard upcycling recipe copies and replicates the dense MLP to each expert. As the router directs different tokens to each expert, the experts will start to diverge from one another, and their initial MLP weights. Figure 13 explores whether loading the MLPs is indeed a good idea, or whether the model would be better off learning the experts from scratch (random initialization). We train for 7 extra epochs (dense was trained for 14 epochs, and we keep training up to a total of 21). Note that the computational cost of both approaches is identical. It takes a long time for the model with randomly initialized experts to recover and catch up with the algorithm that upcycles the expert weights from the dense MLP layers, regardless of the number of experts. We also tried an intermediate approach (not shown), where we only upcycle a subset of experts and initialize the rest of scratch, but that also underperformed upcycling all of the experts. ![](_page_20_Figure_1.jpeg) Figure 13: Performance comparison between upcycling experts ("Load Experts = True") and randomly initializing the experts ("Load Experts = False"). We include upstream (top row) and downstream (bottom row) performance metrics, and also ablate the number of experts per MoE layer (over the columns). #### B.6 RESUMING THE OPTIMIZER STATE When upcycling a model, we can resume the optimizer state from the original dense checkpoint together with the model parameters. Figure 14 shows that reusing the optimizer state gives a performance boost for vision models, independent of the number of experts.6 We did not, however, see any improvement from reusing the dense model optimizer state in our language experiments, so we only reuse the optimizer state for vision models. #### B.7 COMBINE WEIGHT NORMALIZATION AFTER ROUTING A simple trick that we found useful for the upcycling of vision models was to normalize the combine weights after routing. The weights of each token are normalized so that the sum is 1. This follows that intuition that each token was previously only processed by a single "expert" MLP in the dense model. In the event that a token is not routed at all, the combine weights remain 0. We illustrate this normalization trick with two simple examples. **Several experts selected.** Suppose a token x is selected by three different experts $e_1, e_2$ and $e_3$ with routing weights $w_1 = 0.3, w_2 = 0.2$ , and $w_3 = 0.1$ respectively (adding up to 0.6). The normalized weights are: $$\bar{w}_1 = \frac{0.3}{0.6} = 0.5, \qquad \bar{w}_2 = \frac{0.2}{0.6} = 0.3333... \qquad \bar{w}_3 = \frac{0.1}{0.6} = 0.1666...$$ The final output x' is: $$x' = \bar{w}_1 \cdot e_1(x) + \bar{w}_2 \cdot e_2(x) + \bar{w}_3 \cdot e_3(x).$$

Routing design decisions can make a significant difference in ameliorating this drop. 430 431 Section B.2 ablates the long-term upcycled model performance as a function of the capacity factor C. Figure 15 shows the immediate effect of modifying C on the upcycled model. Increasing C reduces the likelihood that tokens are dropped; when routing weights are normalized to sum to 1 (see Section B.7), the upcycled model is exactly equivalent to the dense model for those tokens selected by at least one expert. Note the set of tokens not selected by any expert decreases in size as we increase C. 432 433 Note that although different routing mechanisms significantly impact the starting point for upcycling, the subsequent training can smooth over many differences. For example, at the start Top-K routing is clearly worse than Expert Choice with weight normalization, but Table 2 shows that a model upcycled with Top-K routing eventually catches up. 434 435 Figure 16 shows the effect of the group size parameter. Routing, and in particular the top-k operations, are performed in groups. Using smaller group sizes will speed up routing, but will lead to higher variance in expert assignment across groups. For smaller groups, we may expect more tokens to be dropped (not selected by any expert). 436 437 How many MoE layers we upcycle, and where we place those layers, also affects the initial performance drop. <sup>6For some parameter, such as the router weights, we do not have any original optimizer state that we can reuse. ![](_page_21_Figure_1.jpeg) Figure 14: Performance comparison between reusing ("Load Optimizer = True") and not reusing ("Load Optimizer = False") the optimizer state. We include upstream (top row) and downstream (bottom row) performance metrics, and also ablate the number of experts per MoE layer (over the columns). Table 3: Training from scratch on V-MoE-B/32 vision models with Expert Choice routing. Comparison with and without weight renormalization after routing. | Capacity | Renormalization | Val Prec@1 | ImageNet 10shot | |---------------|-----------------|------------|-----------------| | C = 1 $C = 1$ | No | 48.71 | 69.68 | | | Yes | 48.23 | 70.19 | | C = 2 $C = 2$ | No | 50.02 | 71.26 | | | Yes | 49.75 | 71.55 | Only one expert selected. In this case, regardless of the selected weight $w_1$ , the output routing weight will be $\bar{w}_1 = 1.0$ after normalizing it: $$x' = \bar{w}_1 \cdot e_1(x) = 1.0 \cdot e_1(x).$$ While this approach can be in principle a bit problematic (those tokens only selected by one expert have vanishing routing gradients), Table 3 shows that, even if we are training vision models from scratch, applying weight normalization does not hurt performance (while it indeed helps for upcycling). However, router weight normalization was not helpful for language models. Upstream accuracy after 1M steps was comparable: 70.8% (no normalization) vs 70.7% (normalization), but downstream average scores on SuperGLUE lagged: 79.3% (no normalization) vs 78.8% (normalization). A similar quality degradation were observed in MoE language models trained from scratch. One hypothesis for this different behavior is that the vision models use Expert Choice routing everywhere, but the language models use Expert Choice in the encoder and Top-K routing in the decoder. ![](_page_22_Figure_1.jpeg) Figure 15: The effect of capacity size ratio on the initial performance of B/16 (left) and L/16 (right) models after upcycling (i.e. at the very first new step); when routing weights are normalized (Section B.7), and capacity is large, the upcycled model retains the dense model's function. # B.8 CLOSER LOOK AT DESIGN CHOICES IMMEDIATELY FOLLOWING UPCYCLING Once a model is upcycled, there is a drop in performance due to the sudden deviation from the dense model's learned function, even with MoE experts reusing the dense MLP weights. Routing design decisions can make a significant difference in ameliorating this drop. Section B.2 ablates the long-term upcycled model performance as a function of the capacity factor C. Figure 15 shows the immediate effect of modifying C on the upcycled model. Increasing C reduces the likelihood that tokens are dropped; when routing weights are normalized to sum to 1 (see Section B.7), the upcycled model is exactly equivalent to the dense model for those tokens selected by at least one expert. Note the set of tokens not selected by any expert decreases in size as we increase C. Note that although different routing mechanisms significantly impact the starting point for upcycling, the subsequent training can smooth over many differences. For example, at the start Top-K routing is clearly worse than Expert Choice with weight normalization, but Table 2 shows that a model upcycled with Top-K routing eventually catches up. Figure 16 shows the effect of the group size parameter. Routing, and in particular the top-k operations, are performed in groups. Using smaller group sizes will speed up routing, but will lead to higher variance in expert assignment across groups. For smaller groups, we may expect more tokens to be dropped (not selected by any expert). How many MoE layers we upcycle, and where we place those layers, also affects the initial performance drop. Figure 17 shows the effect of this in the initial drop for Expert Choice routing, using normalized combined weights (Section B.7) Upcycling the bottom layers causes a larger initial performance drop. Upcycling the last layers consecutive layers or interleaving them —as in every other layer—yields the smallest initial performance drop. Finally, we analyze how the number of experts per MoE layer affects the initial upcycling. Figure 18 suggests that routing to more experts leads to a heavier drop. Figure 12 shows that upcycled models can recover from this eventually though, and sometimes even achieve higher performance. ## B.9 THINGS THAT DID NOT WORK We list several unsuccessful attempts, beyond the preceding ablations, to improve the performance of the upcycling. Adding (truncated) Gaussian noise to router weights, expert weights or both, in an effort to diversify the router or expert weights, did not help. Modifiying the learning rate of experts, routers or both, to account for the fact that the addition of sparsity may demand different learning rate from the rest of the model, generally hurt performance; increasing the learning rates sometimes rendered the models more unstable. We attempted to add a fixed temperature term to the softmax of ![](_page_23_Figure_1.jpeg) Figure 16: Increasing group size does not significantly affect performance using Expert Choice routing, but improves initial performance for Top-K routing. ![](_page_23_Figure_3.jpeg) Figure 17: Effect of position and number of MoE layers on the initial performance after upcycling (i.e. at the very first new step). Note that L/16 models have more MLP layers.. ![](_page_23_Figure_5.jpeg) Figure 18: Effect of the number of experts per MoE layer on the initial drop of ImageNet 10-shot performance (i.e. at step 1), for B/16 and L/16 upcycled models with 6 MoE layers and C=1. The initial performance is lower when using more experts. router to encourage more random or less random routing. We also varied the initialization scheme for the router, included the router z-loss [\(Zoph et al., 2022\)](#page-13-2). Unfortunately, none of these attempts led to any significant performance improvement. | | | | ( | he

4	  - 实现：SonicMoE 在算法层面有两个核心创新：(1) **Memory-efficient MoE backward 算法**——重新设计 MoE 的计算图，使得 activation memory 不随 expert granularity G=d/n 增长。关键洞察：传统 MoE backward 需要缓存 down-proj 输出 Y（size=2TKd bytes），SonicMoE 通过推导 dS 和 dH 的替代计算路径——dS = ⟨dA', A⟩ 替代 dS = ⟨dO, Y⟩、dH 通过 dSwiGLU(dA, H) 从 H 重新计算——避免缓存 Y，并将 X_e 和 dO_e 的 gather 与 HBM load 融合消除物化。结果：activation memory = 2Td + 4TKn bytes per layer（与相同 activated params 的 dense model 相同），不随 G 增长。(2) **Token Rounding (TR) Routing**——一种 tile-aware 的路由方法：在 token-choice top-K 路由结果基础上，将每个 expert 接收的 token 数 f_e 舍入到 GEMM tile size M_tile（默认128）的最近倍数。算法两阶段：(a) 计算 top-K TC 结果；(b) 构建 EC 排序分数 S'（TC 选中 token 保持原分数，未选中减1确保 TC token 优先），对每个 expert 从 S' 按分数排序选择 tile-rounded 数量的 token。round_and_sparsify 子例程决定 padding（选择额外 EC tokens）或 discarding（丢弃最后 TC tile 的 tokens），每个 expert 偏离 TC 结果最多 1 tile。TR 保证期望总 token 数不变但消除 Grouped GEMM padding 浪费。
5	  - 实验比较：(a) **Activation Memory**：SonicMoE vs ScatterMoE/MoMoE/MegaBlocks/DeepGEMM，在 1.4B~120B MoE 配置下 per-layer peak memory，SonicMoE 减少 20%~159%；(b) **Forward/Backward TFLOPS**：SonicMoE vs all baselines，7B MoE (n=256) 上 forward TFLOPS +43% vs DeepGEMM，backward +83% vs ScatterMoE, +115% vs MoMoE；(c) **Token Rounding 质量**：TR vs TC top-K vs EC vs TC(token drop) 在 0.5B/1.4B/1.8B MoE 上的 train/val PPL 和 11 个下游任务 accuracy（Wino/SIQA/SciQ/PIQA/OBQA/HS/COPA/CSQA/BoolQ/ArcE/ArcC）；(d) **TR 训练吞吐**：TR vs TC top-K 在稀疏 MoE 配置下的 MoE kernel TFLOPS；(e) **TR Ablation**：rounding subroutine (NR-f/SR-f/NR-s/Balance-f/UP/DOWN)、microbatch size T、tile size M_tile 对模型质量的影响；(f) **Expert Granularity 影响**：iso-FLOPs 下 n=1024/256/64 的 MoE 质量对比。

32	    For each expert e in [E]:

34	      dA'_e = dO_e W_{2,e}^T                      # [T_e, n]
35	      s_e = Gather(S, π_{:,e})
36	      dA_e = Broadcast(s_e) * dA'_e              # 替代 dA = dY W_2^T
37	      A_e, dH_e = dSwiGLU(dA_e, H_e)             # 从 H 重算 A

39	      dS_{e,t} = ⟨dA'_{e,t}, A_{e,t}⟩            # reduce over n, 替代 ⟨dO, Y⟩
40	    
41	    # dW2 kernel: 使用 A' 而非 A
42	    For each expert e in [E]:
43	      dO_e = Gather(dO, π_{:,e})
44	      dW_{2,e} = A'_e^T dO_e                     # 等价于 A_e^T dY_e

132	## Scaling Beyond the GPU Memory Limit for Large Mixture-of-Experts Model Training
133	
134	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
135	  - 实现：ES-MoE——一种面向大规模MoE模型训练的可扩展系统，核心机制包括：(1) **Expert-wise offloading**：将expert参数和optimizer state卸载到CPU内存/SSD，仅保留non-expert参数、当前使用中expert的参数及激活值在GPU显存中，突破GPU内存限制；(2) **Pipelined expert processing**：在token permutation阶段重叠第1个expert的CPU→GPU上传，后续expert顺序处理时重叠前一个expert计算与下一个expert上传，最大化GPU利用率；(3) **Expert-wise CPU optimization**：每个expert完成backward pass后即刻触发CPU optimizer更新，而非等待整个layer完成，使layers靠近output的优化被layers靠近input的GPU计算隐藏；(4) **Sequential expert computation**（非batched matrix multiplication）：避免创建大的dispatch mask，节省显存以支持更大microbatch；(5) **Dynamic expert placement**：采用greedy scheduling（minimizing makespan的4/3-approximation算法），按token负载将experts动态分配给各GPU，消除zero-padding；(6) **Adaptive offloading**：根据模型能否放入聚合GPU内存自动选择三种模式：GPU only / CPU offload + expert pinning / CPU+SSD offload。基于Fairseq实现，采用DeepSpeed的CPU Adam optimizer，共3300行Python + 3000行C++代码。
136	  - 实验比较：(a) 训练吞吐量比较：ES-MoE vs Zero-Offload^E vs FairSeq vs Tutel，在MoE-S/M/L不同expert数量(8/16/32/64)下；(b) 可扩展性：各框架在4 GPU下能支持的最大expert数量及model size；(c) microbatch size变化对吞吐量的影响（MoE-M 16 experts）；(d) ablation study：逐项消除expert pinning/optimizer overlap/larger batch/zero-padding elimination的影响；(e) LLM fine-tuning：Fairseq-MoE-15B在SST-2/MNLI/BoolQ数据集上用4 GPU fine-tune 100M tokens的准确率；(f) GPU utilization对比（ES-MoE vs Zero-Offload^E，不同expert数量下）

215	  - 实现：提出一种面向MoE计算的**双端结构化稀疏数据格式（N:M:V）**。权重端采用两层稀疏：(1) 2:4 element-wise稀疏对齐SpTC的ISA要求（50% sparse ratio，每个连续4元素保留2个非零值）；(2) vector-wise稀疏（Sub-Row level），权重划分为 $M \times V$ 的块，每块内仅保留N个Sub-Row，提供灵活稀疏比（可超50%）。激活端采用vector-wise稀疏，通过SEL（selection array）记录token routing后的有效列。原始权重编码为三部分：data矩阵（压缩后的非零值，shape $\frac{m}{M} \times \frac{k}{2}$）、indices矩阵（记录保留Sub-Row的位置，shape $\frac{m}{M} \times \frac{k}{V}$）、metadata矩阵（每SpTC单元的2-bit稀疏模式，shape $\frac{m}{M} \times \frac{k}{2}$）。剪枝过程与推理解耦，可集成SOTA剪枝方法（WoodFisher/SparseGPT），使用SparseML框架的WoodFisher方法。

301	      router_logits = einsum('bd,dn->bn', token_embeddings, router_weights)

305	      top_n_gates = top_n_gates / sum(top_n_gates, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

307	      for i in range(1, n):  # for 2nd..nth expert

312	          rand < (top_n_gates[:, i] / threshold)

343	## S'MoRE: Structural Mixture of Residual Experts for LLM Fine-tuning
344	
345	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
346	  - 实现：**S'MoRE** 是一个层次化结构式残差专家混合（Structural Mixture of Residual Experts）PEFT adapter 框架。核心设计：(1) **层次化低秩残差分解**：将每个 expert 的权重矩阵分解为多阶残差项的和 $W^i \approx \sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1} B^i_\ell \cdot A^i_\ell$，其中每阶残差 $B^i_\ell \cdot A^i_\ell$ 为低秩矩阵（秩 $r_\ell$），各阶残差排列为 L 层结构。(2) **树形路由（Hierarchical Routing）**：路由器自顶向下（从层 L 到层 1）逐层选择子节点 expert，对每个父节点 expert i，计算条件概率 $p(i_{\ell-1} \mid i_{L-1}, \dots, i_\ell, x)$，选择 top-$f_{\ell-1}$ 子节点，形成深度为 L 的激活树。(3) **自底向上聚合传播**：token 沿激活树从层 1 到层 L 传播，每层 $\ell+1$ 执行 $x_{\ell+1}^i = \sum_{n \in \mathcal{N}_\ell^i} \alpha_\ell^{i,n} \cdot \sigma(B_\ell^n \cdot A_\ell^n \cdot x + W_\ell \cdot x_\ell^n)$，其中 $\sigma$ 为非线性激活（ReLU 等），$W_\ell$ 为层间投影矩阵。最终输出经 $W_{\text{proj}} \in \mathbb{R}^{d_L \times d}$ 投影回原维度。(4) **维度设计**：中间层输出维度 $d_{\ell+1} = d_\ell + s_\ell \cdot r_\ell$，保证无信息损失且计算高效，总参数量近似 $2 \cdot d \cdot d_L$，与 vanilla LoRA（rank $d_L$）相同。(5) **路由器实现**：每个 expert i 有一个可学习的 key vector $k_\ell^i \in \mathbb{R}^m$，MLP 根据 token embedding x 和祖先 key vectors 生成 query vector q，路由概率 $\alpha_\ell^i = \text{softmax}(\langle k_\ell^i, q \rangle)$。先将 x 投影到低维 $x_{\text{down}}$（如 d=4096, $d_{\text{down}}=24$）再输入 MLP 以减少计算。

357	
358	  # 阶段1: 自顶向下路由 (Top-Down Routing)
359	  x_down = W_down @ x          # [d_down], d_down << d (e.g., 24)
360	
361	  # Layer 2 路由 (选择顶层 experts)
362	  q_1 = MLP_1(x_down)          # [m]
363	  scores_1 = softmax(K_1 @ q_1)  # [s_1], K_1 shape [s_1, m], s_1=4
364	  activated_L2 = top_k(scores_1, k=f_1)  # 选择 f_1=2 个顶层 experts

366	  # Layer 1 路由 (为每个顶层 expert 选择子节点)
367	  for each parent p in activated_L2:
368	      q_0 = MLP_0(concat(x_down, k_1^p))  # [m], 条件于父节点
369	      scores_0 = softmax(K_0 @ q_0)        # [s_0], s_0=4
370	      children[p] = top_k(scores_0, k=f_0) # 每个父节点选 f_0=2 子节点
371	
372	  # 阶段2: 自底向上聚合 (Bottom-Up Aggregation)
373	  # Layer 1 聚合
374	  d_1 = s_0 * r_0  # 输出维度, e.g., 4*8=32
375	  for each parent p:
376	      x_1^p = zeros(d_1)
377	      for each child n in children[p]:
378	          # B_0^n: [d_1, r_0], A_0^n: [r_0, d]
379	          x_1^p += alpha_0^{p,n} * ReLU(B_0^n @ A_0^n @ x + W_0 @ x_0^n)
380	          # x_0^n 不存在于第1层 (d_0=0)
381	
382	  # Layer 2 聚合 (最终输出)
383	  d_2 = d_1 + s_1 * r_1  # 输出维度, e.g., 32+4*8=64
384	  x_2 = zeros(d_2)
385	  for each activated top expert i:
386	      for each child n of i:
387	          x_2 += alpha_1^{i,n} * ReLU(B_1^n @ A_1^n @ x + W_1 @ x_1^{i->n})
388	
389	  # 最终投影
390	  x' = W_proj @ x_2  # [d], W_proj shape [d, d_2]
391	
392	  # Adapter 输出加回预训练权重输出

398	## Remoe: Towards Efficient and Low-Cost MoE Inference in Serverless Computing
399	
400	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
401	  - 实现：**SPS（Similar Prompts Searching）算法**用于 prompt 级 expert 激活分布预测。核心流程：(1) **离线阶段**：对所有历史 prompt 计算 pairwise Soft Cosine Similarity (SCS)，构建多叉聚类树。节点（cluster）超过 β 个 prompt 时递归划分，使用定制 k-medoids 聚类（roulette wheel sampling 初始化质心，subcluster 级质心更新），距离度量为 SCS。α < β 以支持 leaf 内局部暴力搜索。(2) **在线预测**：新 prompt 遍历聚类树到 leaf，若 leaf 内样本不足 α，回退到 sibling nodes 补充。对检索到的 α 个历史 prompt，将其 SCS 值经 softmax 转为概率权重，加权求和其 expert 激活分布矩阵得到预测结果。(3) **SCS 计算**：对两个 prompt ζ1, ζ2，归一化并拼接 token embedding 矩阵，乘以其转置得到对称 token 相似度矩阵 C_{ζ1,ζ2}，构造 alignment vectors V1, V2（binary 标记 token 归属），SCS = (V1^T C V2) / (√(V1^T C V1) * √(V2^T C V2) + σ)。
402	  - 实验比较：(1) **SPS vs 6个baseline**：VarPAM（替换 k-medoids 为 PAM 聚类）、VarED（替换距离度量为 expert 激活分布的 Euclidean 距离）、DOP（直接用历史激活作为预测）、Fate（用前一层的 hidden states 预测，调整为用初始 prompt embedding 预测所有层）、EF（假设所有 expert 激活频率相等）、BF（暴力搜索 top-α 语义相似 prompt）；(2) 在 **LMSYS-Chat-1M、WikiText-2、C4、SlimPajama** 四个数据集上对比 JS Divergence（预测 vs 真实 expert 激活分布），5000 train + 500 test samples；(3) 聚类树构建时间对比（SPS ≤ 0.5s vs VarPAM 需数小时），搜索速度对比（SPS 比 BF 快 10 倍以上）。

439	  - 实现：基于 MoE 模型训练过程中 expert 负载的时序特征分析，部署三种经典预测算法（LSTM-based、ARIMA-based、Sliding Window Average-based）对 expert 负载分布进行高精度预测。核心设计分为两阶段：(1) 通过大量训练实验追踪 GPT-3 125M 和 GPT-3 350M 在不同滑动窗口（10/100/200）下的 expert 负载方差（variance）和极差（range），定义 transient state（早期训练迭代中负载显著波动）和 stable state（经过一定迭代后负载呈现 temporal locality，相邻迭代间变化小）；(2) 针对两种状态的特征，部署三种预测算法：LSTM-based 以所有 expert 在各 MoE 层的历史负载比例作为输入，输出未来 k 步的负载比例值；ARIMA-based 对每条 expert 负载时间序列执行平稳性和季节性检验以选择 (p,d,q) 参数，一般形式为 (1-ΣφᵢLⁱ)(1-L)ᵈX_t = (1+ΣθⱼLʲ)ε_t；SW Avg-based 直接取历史多轮负载比例的算术平均作为下一轮预测值，通过 k 轮滑动计算预测未来负载。
440	  - 实验比较：(1) LSTM-based vs ARIMA-based vs SW Avg-based 在 GPT-3 125M 和 GPT-3 350M 上对比预测误差率，评估指标为各 MoE 层 expert 负载比例的滑动预测均值误差率；(2) 三种算法在 transient state（early iterations）和 stable state（after ~5,000 iterations）的误差率变化趋势对比；(3) 短期预测（1,000 iterations）和长期预测（2,000 iterations）的算法性能差异；(4) SW Avg-based 作为硬件友好型方法的计算效率分析。

453	  - 算法 pipeline 核心流程：
454	    - **Phase 1: 负载数据采集与状态分析**
455	      对每个训练 iteration t，记录 MoE layer l 中 expert i 的负载比例 n_i^l(t) = tokens_processed_by_expert_i / total_tokens_in_layer。设定滑动窗口大小 w（10/100/200），计算窗口内各 expert 负载的方差 variance_i = Var(n_i^l(t) ... n_i^l(t-w+1)) 和极差 range_i = max - min，通过方差和极差的时序变化识别 transient → stable 状态转换。以 GPT-3 125M 为例，~5,000 iterations 后进入 stable state。
456	    - **Phase 2: LSTM-based 预测**
457	      输入：历史 expert 负载数据 [n_1^1, n_2^1, ..., n_1^2, n_2^2, ..., n_e^m]（将所有 MoE 层所有 expert 的历史负载数据展平为一维向量），其中 n_j^i 表示第 i 个 MoE 层中第 j 个 expert 的负载比例历史序列。输出：所有 expert 在未来 k 次 iteration 的负载比例值。LSTM 模型学习 expert 负载的时序变化模式，两次独立训练数据分别作为 train/test set。
458	    - **Phase 3: ARIMA-based 预测**
459	      对每个 expert 的时间序列数据 n_i^l(t)，执行平稳性检验（判断 d 差分阶数）和季节性检验（判断 p 自回归阶数、q 移动平均阶数）。具体参数：ARIMA(5,1,5) 即 p=5, d=1, q=5。模型形式：(1-L)X_t = (1+θ₁L+θ₂L²+θ₃L³+θ₄L⁴+θ₅L⁵)/(1-φ₁L-φ₂L²-φ₃L³-φ₄L⁴-φ₅L⁵) · ε_t。目标是最小化预测误差以获取准确未来预测。
460	    - **Phase 4: SW Avg-based 预测**
461	      最简方法：predicted_load_i = (1/w) Σ_{j=t-w+1}^{t} n_i(j)，即取最近 w 轮历史数据的算术平均作为下一轮预测值。对未来 k 轮迭代，每轮使用最新的预测结果作为下一轮的历史数据输入（即滚动预测）。该方法计算效率极高，对硬件友好。
462	    - **关键结果**：GPT-3 125M stable state——LSTM 误差率 <1%, ARIMA ~0.5%, SW Avg ~0.25%；GPT-3 350M stable state (1,000-step prediction)——LSTM <10%, ARIMA ~1.4%, SW Avg ~1.3%；(2,000-step prediction)——SW Avg ~1.7%。SW Avg 在三种算法中表现最佳，且在 transient state（前 5,000 iterations）误差率逐步下降。
463	    - **应用价值**：预测结果可为 expert placement（如 FlexMoE 的启发式算法）或 resource allocation 提供指导——stable state 下可基于预测进行细粒度资源分配，transient state 下则需预留充足资源应对负载爆发。

467	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
468	  - 实现：将预训练 dense LLM（Llama2-7B-chat）通过 activation sparsity **refactorize** 为更小的 MoE 模型（4.7B activated / 17B total）。核心算法 pipeline 分三步：(1) **Domain-Aware Expert Construction**：利用训练语料元数据将语料分为 N 个子域（Arxiv, Books, C4, Common Crawl, Github, Wikipedia, StackExchange），对每个子域 D_i 计算特征通道的平均激活幅度（activation magnitude），通过结构化 pruning 保留 top-activated 神经元构造 domain expert。形式化为选择矩阵 M_i ∈ {0,1}^{d×D}（d≈D/2），最大化 E[||M_i W_1 x||_1]。(2) **Pre-Gating Router**：提出单层 Transformer block（1-layer, 4-head, 18M params, SwiGLU FFN, RoPE, RMSNorm）作为跨所有 layer 共享的 router，替代传统逐层 router。Router 以 causal attention 方式考虑当前及历史 token 信息进行 expert 选择，消除逐层 router 的冗余。(3) **Continual Training with Routing Distillation Loss**：随机初始化 router，冻结 expert 先优化 router 100 steps（L_RD = KL(softmax(G(x)) || softmax([||M_0 M_1^T||_F^2, ...]))），后冻结 router 优化 expert 200 steps（language modeling loss），迭代 8 rounds。总共仅用 1.04B tokens（vs Llama2 预训练 2T tokens）。额外设计 permanent expert 处理所有 token 共享的知识。

484	    - **Phase 1: Domain-Aware Expert Construction（结构化 pruning 初始化 expert）**
485	      输入：预训练 dense LLM FFN 权重 W_1 ∈ R^{D×h}, W_2 ∈ R^{h×D}, 子域数据集 {D_1,...,D_N}。
486	      对每个子域 D_i：
487	      1. 前向传播：对 D_i 中样本 x，计算中间激活 a = W_1 x ∈ R^D。
488	      2. 计算通道平均激活幅度：ā = E_{x~D_i}[|a|] ∈ R^D。
489	      3. 选择 top-d 个最大激活通道：构造选择矩阵 M_i ∈ {0,1}^{d×D}，满足 M_i 1_D = 1（每行选一个通道），M_i^T 1_d ≤ 1（每列最多被选一次），最大化 E[||M_i W_1 x||_1]。
490	      4. 初始化 expert i：F_i(x) = W_2 M_i^T σ(M_i W_1 x)，其中 d ≈ D/2。
491	      5. 识别所有数据共享激活的通道 → 构造 permanent expert（对所有 token 激活）。
492	      - 分层对齐：对所有 layer 联合优化 mask，确保同一 domain 在不同 layer 选择相同索引的 expert。
493	    - **Phase 2: Continual Training（8 rounds 交替优化）**
494	      Router Tuning Stage（100 steps/round, batch_size=64, seq_len=4096, LR=5e-4 cosine decay）：
495	      - 冻结所有 expert 权重。
496	      - 前向计算：router G 接受 x_{≤t}（含 causal attention），输出 gating weights G(x_{≤t}) ∈ R^N。
497	      - 路由蒸馏损失：对 predicted token x_{t+1} 喂入原始 dense 模型，计算 top-50% magnitude mask M_0。L_RD = KL(softmax(G(x_{≤t+1})) || softmax([||M_0 M_1^T||_F^2, ..., ||M_0 M_N^T||_F^2]))。此损失鼓励 router 选择与 dense 模型激活稀疏模式一致的 expert。
498	      - 优化 router 参数。
499	      Expert Tuning Stage（200 steps/round, batch_size=128, seq_len=4096, LR=5e-5 cosine decay）：
500	      - 冻结 router 权重。
501	      - 对每个 token x_t，router 输出 top-K expert 索引（K=2 + permanent expert）。
502	      - 仅计算选中 expert 的 FFN 输出：y_t = Σ_{i: selected} G(x_{≤t})_i · F_i^{(l)}(x_t)。
503	      - 优化 expert 权重（language modeling cross-entropy loss）。
504	      - LR 跨 round 指数衰减（decay rate 0.8, weight decay 0.01）。
505	      总计 8 rounds × (26M + 105M) = 1.04B tokens。
506	    - **Phase 3: Inference with Pre-Gating**
507	      推理时：对每个 token sequence (x_1,...,x_T)，先用 router G 一次性计算所有 layer 的 expert 选择（因 router 与 layer index 无关，expert 选择跨 layer 一致）。然后 layer-wise forward：每层仅激活 router 选择的 2 experts + 1 permanent expert。

510	## PuzzleMoE Efficient Compression of Large Mixture-of-Experts Models via Sparse Expert Merging and Bit-packed inference
511	
512	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
513	  - 实现：PuzzleMoE 是一种 training-free MoE 压缩方法，核心包括两部分：(1) **Pairwise Dual-Mask Sparse Expert Merging**——对每对 expert 的权重矩阵 W^i, W^j ∈ R^{d×h}，构造两张互补 mask：Similarity-based mask M^sim = 1_{Δ ≤ τ_sim}（通过 symmetric percent difference Δ = ||W_i|-|W_j|| / (|W_i|+|W_j|) 识别元素级相似的共享权重），Saliency-based mask M_i^sal = 1_{A_i ≥ A_j}（通过 activation-aware saliency A_i = |W_i| ⊙ ||X_i||_2 保留各 expert 的关键权重）。最终 merged weight 为 W_merged = M^sim ⊙ (|W_i|+|W_j|)/2 + (1-M^sim) ⊙ (M_i^sal ⊙ |W_i| + M_j^sal ⊙ |W_j|)。(2) **Bit-packed Encoding**——观察到 Bfloat16 权重的 exponent 范围集中在 112-128（仅需 5 bits），通过 shift 操作将 exponent 映射到 [0,31]，释放出 3 bits 用于嵌入 binary mask 和 sign bit，实现 metadata-free 存储。
514	  - 实验比较：(1) 与 expert dropping 方法 (NAEE, STUN) 和 expert merging 方法 (D2, HC-SMoE, Sub-MoE) 在 25%/50% sparsity 下对比 zero-shot accuracy（8 benchmarks: WikiText-2 PPL, ARC-c, ARC-e, HellaSwag, PIQA, BoolQ, Winogrande, MMLU）；(2) 与 Wanda 2:4 semi-structured sparsity 对比（仅对 expert 模块剪枝）；(3) Domain-specific reasoning 评估（GSM8K 8-shot, Math-500, AIME24/25）；(4) 压缩效率对比（compression time, memory usage, inference speedup）；(5) 与 quantization 结合（PuzzleMoE 50% sparsity + 3-bit quantization，与 NAEE 25% + 4-bit AWQ 和纯 3-bit AWQ 对比）。

526	  - 算法 pipeline 张量计算流程：
527	    - **Phase 1: Dual-Mask Construction（离线压缩）**
528	      对每对 expert pair (i, j):
529	      1. 输入 activation 采样：calibration data 传入模型，收集每层各 expert 的输入 activation X_i, X_j ∈ R^{B×h}（仅需一次 forward pass）。
530	      2. Activation saliency 计算：A_i = |W_i| ⊙ ||X_i||_2, A_j = |W_j| ⊙ ||X_j||_2（沿 batch 维取 L2 norm）。
531	      3. Similarity mask：Δ = ||W_i| - |W_j|| / (|W_i| + |W_j|)，M^sim[p,q] = 1 若 Δ[p,q] ≤ 0.4，否则 0。
532	      4. Saliency mask：M_i^sal[p,q] = 1 若 A_i[p,q] ≥ A_j[p,q]，否则 0；M_j^sal = 1 - M_i^sal。
533	      5. Sparse merging：M_i = M_i^sal ∨ M^sim, M_j = M_j^sal ∨ M^sim。|W_merged| = M^sim ⊙ (|W_i|+|W_j|)/2 + (1-M^sim) ⊙ (M_i^sal ⊙ |W_i| + M_j^sal ⊙ |W_j|)。
534	      6. Sign 提取：S_i = 1_{W_i < 0}, S_j = 1_{W_j < 0}。
535	    - **Phase 2: Bit-packing（离线编码）**
536	      1. Exponent shift：所有 W_merged 中 Bfloat16 exponent < 112 的 round up 到 112，然后全部减 112，将 exponent 映射到 [0,31]（5 bits）。
537	      2. Pack masks & signs：释放的 3 个 exponent bits 用于存储 M_i/p（expert position 0/1）对应的 2 bits mask + 1 bit sign。
538	      3. Perplexity 验证：Mixtral-8x7B Wikitext2 PPL before pack=4.37, after pack=4.37；Deepseek-MoE before=6.88, after=6.88。
539	    - **Phase 3: Inference with CUDA GEMV Decoding Kernel（在线推理）**
540	      对每个 packed weight W[i,j]：
541	      1. mask_bit ← (W ≫ (13 - expert_pos)) & 1（提取 mask bit）。
542	      2. 若 mask_bit == 0：W_decoded ← 0（该位置对此 expert 无效）。
543	      3. 否则：sign_bit ← (W ≫ (15 - expert_pos)) & 1；exp ← (W & 0x0F80) + (112 ≪ 7)（恢复原始 exponent）；W_decoded ← (sign_bit ≪ 15) | exp | (W & 0x007F)（重构 Bfloat16）。
544	      4. 执行 GEMV：Output = X @ W_decoded^T。
545	    - **核心权衡**：τ_sim 控制压缩-精度 trade-off——τ_sim=0 仅保留 saliency mask（等效纯剪枝），τ_sim 过大会过度平均化破坏 expert 差异。τ_sim∈[0.3, 0.5] 最优。

550	  - 实现：ProMoE 的算法层面核心是 **Learned Predictor + GoodPred Metric + Stride Prefetching** 三位一体的预测性 expert 预取算法。(1) **GoodPred Metric**——定义预测器评估指标 GoodPred = Accuracy × FetchRate，其中 Accuracy = 正确预测的 experts 比例，FetchRate = 预测 experts 中能在被访问前完成 prefetch 的比例。GoodPred 同时考虑预测质量和时效性。(2) **Learned Predictor**——二层 MLP（~2M 参数/layer），offline 阶段在 domain dataset 上收集每层 gate function 的 (input, output) pair traces（9:1 train/test split），训练 MLP 学习 layer input → expert selection 的映射。online 阶段每层输入 hidden state → MLP predictor → softmax → Top-K expert indices 作为预测结果。Across models 平均 accuracy 84.7%，远高于 token-based predictor（58.3%）和 skip-based predictor（66.9%-varies）。(3) **Stride Prefetching**——将预测距离加 1（预测 N+1 层而非 N 层），使预测与 prefetch 实现 pipeline 并行。预测在 CPU 执行（~200μs latency），与 GPU LLM 推理完全并行，最大化 FetchRate。stride 带来的 accuracy 下降仅 ~5%。

644	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
645	  - 实现：PreMoE 的 Predicted Expert Utility (PEU) 是一种训练无关（training-free）的 MoE Expert 重要性评估与剪枝算法。核心设计分为两阶段：(1) 高置信度过滤——TopK 过滤将候选池缩小为 Top-K_a 个 expert（K_a 匹配模型默认激活数，如 DeepSeek-R1 为 8），然后自适应阈值过滤 r_l = E_x[max_i p_i^l(x)] 逐层计算 local softmax 概率阈值，仅保留概率超过阈值的 expert；(2) Logit 变换——对通过过滤的 logits 应用 f(s) = max(s, sigmoid(s)) 修正负值 logit 的"0-vs-negative"问题（未被选中的 expert 得分为 0 但可能超过有负 logit 的被选 expert）。最终 PEU_i^T = E_{x∈X_T}[s̃_i(x)] 为 expert i 在领域 T 上的平均高置信度变换 logit。基于 PEU ranking 有两种编译策略：Domain-Specific Specialist（每层保留 Top-M PEU expert）和 High-Efficiency Generalist（合成多领域 token-level scores 后计算 multi-domain PEU 再选 Top-M）。全过程不加载完整模型到内存——仅实例化模型骨架并按 PEU pattern 加载选中 expert weights。
646	  - 实验比较：(1) 三个模型在 specialist 场景对比 Random、Frequency（激活计数）、Act-Logits（仅 TopK 过滤无阈值/logit 变换）、All-Logits（全部 logit 直接平均）、SEER-MoE (Local/Global 变体)、EASY-EP；(2) Generalist 场景对比 Trivial Union baseline；(3) 不同稀疏度 (0%/50%/62.5%/75%) 的 accuracy-efficiency trade-off；(4) PEU ranking validity——Top vs Bottom expert 对比验证排名有效性；(5) 组件消融——逐步叠加 TopK → Threshold Filtering → Logit Transformation；(6) 校准数据效率——1/5/10/50/100 样本 vs 全量对标；(7) Cross-domain generalization——域内专家在域外任务上的性能退化分析。
647	- 硬件平台是什么，配置是什么。
648	  - 64×Ascend 910B2-64GB NPU。校准 pattern collection 离线执行于多 NPU 服务器。部署效率（DeepSeek-R1）：0% sparsity (256 experts/layer) → 64 NPUs, latency 115.35 ms/tok, throughput 52.01 tok/s；50% sparsity (128/layer) → 32 NPUs, 93.72 ms/tok, 64.02 tok/s (+23% throughput)；75% sparsity (64/layer) → 16 NPUs, 73.20 ms/tok, 81.97 tok/s (+58% throughput)。

650	  - 模型：DeepSeek-R1-671B (256 experts/layer, 58 MoE layers, Top-8 routing)，openPangu-Ultra-MoE-718B (256 experts/layer)，Qwen3-30B-A3B (128 experts/layer, 8 active experts)。生成配置：DeepSeek-R1 temperature=0.6 top-p=0.95；openPangu-Ultra temperature=0.7 top-p=1.0；Qwen3-30B-A3B temperature=0.6 top-p=0.95 top-k=20。最大 context length 32,768 tokens（Qwen3 部分 benchmark 38,912）。
651	  - 校准数据集：(1) Math——Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1 "math" split, 800 样本；(2) Science——同上 "stem" split, 200 样本；(3) Code——OpenCoder, opc-sft-stage1 (300 样本) + opc-sft-stage2 (300 样本)，共 600 样本；(4) Generalist 额外——LMSYS-Chat-1M, 600 样本。校准使用问题+完整模型推理输出（含 reasoning 输出显著提升准确率 vs 仅用问题）。

655	  - 算法 pipeline 张量计算流程（以 DeepSeek-R1-671B 为例，256 experts/layer, 58 MoE layers, K_a=8）：
656	    - **阶段1：PEU Pattern 提取（校准阶段）**
657	      对校准集 X_T 中每个 token x，逐层执行：
658	      1. Router 前向：记录 logits s(x) = {s_1(x), ..., s_{256}(x)} ∈ R^{256}
659	      2. TopK 过滤：E_8 = TopK({s_j(x)}, 8) ∈ R^8（仅保留 top-8 logit 的 expert index）
660	      3. Local Softmax：p_i(x) = exp(s_i(x)) / Σ_{k∈E_8} exp(s_k(x)), ∀i∈E_8
661	      4. 自适应阈值：r_l = E_{x∈X_T}[max_{i∈E_8} p_i^l(x)]（逐层独立计算，对每层所有 token 求平均 top-1 softmax 概率）
662	      5. 高置信度过滤：合格条件 i∈E_8 ∧ p_i(x) ≥ r_l
663	      6. Logit 变换：s̃_i(x) = max(s_i(x), sigmoid(s_i(x))) if 合格, else 0
664	      7. PEU 聚合：PEU_i^T = (1/|X_T|) Σ_x s̃_i(x) ∈ R^{256}，得到该层 256 个 expert 的效用排序
665	      最终得 Pattern^T = {{PEU_i^{T,l}}_{i=1}^{256}}_{l=1}^{58}
666	    - **阶段2：编译稀疏实例（内存高效）**
667	      - Specialist: 每层选 Top-M PEU experts → {E_i^r}_{i=1}^M（M=128 at 50% sparsity），裁剪 router weights 移除未选 expert 对应参数
668	      - Generalist: 收集多领域所有 token-level s̃_i(x) → PEU_i^multi = 全 token 平均 → 每层选 Top-M
669	      - 编译：仅初始化模型骨架（不含 expert weights），按 PEU pattern 从磁盘逐层加载选中 expert weights 到 NPU HBM。完整模型从未加载到内存。参数从 670.92B (256/layer) 降至 343.96B (128/layer, 50% sparsity) 或 180.49B (64/layer, 75% sparsity)

671	## Partial Experts Checkpoint: Efficient Fault Tolerance for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Model Training
672	
673	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
674	  - 实现：MoC-System 的核心算法贡献是 Partial Experts Checkpointing (PEC) 机制——一种 algorithm-system co-design 的容错 checkpoint 策略。PEC 在每次 checkpoint 时仅保存每层 MoE 的 K_pec 个 expert（而非全部 N 个），非 expert 部分完整保存。具体算法组件包括：(1) Sequential Selection 策略——在 MoE layers 和 EP ranks 之间以交错轮转的方式选择每次保存哪些 experts，保证 workload 均衡；(2) PLT（Proportion of Lost Tokens）指标——量化学精度损失：PLT = (1/N_moe) Σ_i Σ_j L_{i,j}(I_ckpt, K_pec, F) / (T_i · TopK_i)，其中 L_{i,j} 为第 j 次故障导致的第 i 层 token 丢失数；(3) Snapshot-PEC + Persist-PEC 两级 PEC——分别配置 K_snapshot（GPU→CPU）和 K_persist（CPU→Storage）两个超参数，利用内存高带宽保留更多 expert 状态；(4) Dynamic-K 策略——根据累积故障数动态调整 K_pec：若累积 PLT 超 3.75% 阈值则 K_pec 翻倍，直至恢复保存全部 experts；(5) Adaptive Sharding——针对 PEC 导致的 workload 不平衡，用贪心算法将非 expert 部分分配给负载最轻的 rank。
675	  - 实验比较：(1) 不同 K_pec 值（1~16）下的 checkpoint size 缩减比例（达到 baseline 的 42.3%）；(2) Full Saving vs PEC 的 bottleneck rank workload（等分 sharding、自适应 sharding）；(3) Baseline vs Base-Async vs MoC-Async 的每训练迭代时延（O_save 减少 98.2%-98.9%）；(4) PEC 恢复后 pre-training 的 validation loss curve vs baseline（GPT-350M-16E）；(5) 不同 checkpoint 方法（W/O/WO/WO-2L）在下游 8 个任务上的 accuracy 对比（HellaSwag, PIQA, WinoGrande, BoolQ, ARC-E, OBQA, RACE, MathQA）；(6) Sequential vs Load-aware selection 对 SwinV2-MoE test accuracy 的影响；(7) Dynamic-K 策略下累积 PLT 的变化；(8) Fine-tuning 阶段 PEC 的效果（OLMoE + Alpaca dataset）；(9) ASTRA-SIM 模拟器的 scaling 实验：GPU 数量(8-1024)、并行策略(DP+EP vs DP+EP+TP)、硬件(A800 vs H100)、序列长度(1k-8k)、模型大小(Small/Medium/Large)。

689	    - **PEC 保存（正常训练时）**：每个 checkpoint 迭代执行 snapshot-PEC 和 persist-PEC。给定 MoE layer 的 N 个 experts {E_i} 和选择函数 F_seq（sequential selection）：选择索引 idx = (layer_id + iter_id) mod N，依次取 K_pec 个 expert。Snapshot-PEC：将选中的 K_snapshot 个 expert 的 weights (B_w bytes/param) + optimizer states (B_o bytes/param) 从 GPU 经 PCIe 复制到 CPU memory。Persist-PEC：从 CPU memory 的 K_snapshot 个 expert 中再选 K_persist 个，序列化写入分布式持久存储。Checkpoint size 公式：C_pec ≈ (P_ne + K_pec/N · P_e) · (B_w + B_o)，相比全量 C_full ≈ (P_ne + P_e) · (B_w + B_o) 显著缩减。
690	    - **PEC 恢复（故障后）**：故障节点从持久存储加载 K_persist 个 expert 状态 + 完整非 expert 部分；正常节点可直接从 CPU memory snapshot 恢复 K_snapshot 个 expert（比存储中的更近期），减少 PLT。
691	    - **伪代码**：
692	      ```
693	      # Sequential Selection per checkpoint
694	      for each MoE layer l:
695	          for each checkpoint iteration c:
696	              start_expert = (l + c) % N_experts
697	              save experts[start_expert : start_expert + K_pec]  # wraparound
698	      
699	      # Dynamic-K adjustment after fault recovery
700	      accumulated_plt = compute_plt(current_fault_count, K_pec_current, I_ckpt)
701	      if accumulated_plt > 0.0375:
702	          K_pec = min(K_pec * 2, N_experts)
703	      ```
704	    - **Triple Buffer 异步流程**：三个 buffer（snapshot/persist/recovery）状态机轮转。Snapshot buffer → GPU→CPU 完成后转 persist buffer → CPU→Storage 完成后转 recovery buffer → 可供下一次故障恢复使用。异步线程在每个训练进程内触发，与 forward+backward 重叠。

706	## Diff-MoE: Efficient Batched MoE Inference with Priority-Driven Differential Expert Caching
707	
708	- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
709	  - 实现：Diff-MoE 的优先级驱动差分专家缓存算法（Priority-Driven Differential Expert Caching Algorithm），包含两个核心算法组件：(1) Priority-Based Expert Classification（§4）：离线阶段识别 globally hot experts 并固定优先级 MaxP，在线阶段按公式 p_k^i = clip(p_k^i + Δ_inc | p_k^i - Δ_dec_in | p_k^i - Δ_dec_out) 动态更新 non-global expert 优先级，以 threshold_hot = Δ_inc 为界区分 locally hot 和 cold experts；(2) Locality-Preserving Cache Replacement Policy（§5.2）：候选 experts 按优先级降序排列，MPC resident experts 按优先级升序排列，用最低优先级（且低于 threshold_hot）的 resident 替换最高优先级的候选，直到无符合条件的 resident 或候选。与传统 LRU 对比，该策略用优先级（综合频率+时效）取代纯 recency 作为驱逐决策依据。
710	  - 实验比较：(1) Cache Hit Rate 对比 — Diff-MoE vs MoE-Infinity vs LRU，不同 batch size（1-128）、不同缓存比 α（2%/5%/10%）、不同模型（Switch-Base/Switch-Large）和数据集（XSum/SQuAD）下，Diff-MoE 在 batched 场景显著优于全局共享缓存方案；(2) End-to-End Throughput — 在 5% 缓存比下，Diff-MoE 相比 DeepSpeed-Offload/Pre-gated MoE/MoE-Infinity 分别提升 2.74×/2.22×/1.55×；(3) Memory Efficiency — Diff-MoE 在同样缓存配置下提供最高的 tokens/(GB·s)。

## SonicMoE Accelerating MoE with IO and Tile-aware Optimizations

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：SonicMoE 在算法层面有两个核心创新：(1) **Memory-efficient MoE backward 算法**——重新设计 MoE 的计算图，使得 activation memory 不随 expert granularity G=d/n 增长。关键洞察：传统 MoE backward 需要缓存 down-proj 输出 Y（size=2TKd bytes），SonicMoE 通过推导 dS 和 dH 的替代计算路径——dS = ⟨dA', A⟩ 替代 dS = ⟨dO, Y⟩、dH 通过 dSwiGLU(dA, H) 从 H 重新计算——避免缓存 Y，并将 X_e 和 dO_e 的 gather 与 HBM load 融合消除物化。结果：activation memory = 2Td + 4TKn bytes per layer（与相同 activated params 的 dense model 相同），不随 G 增长。(2) **Token Rounding (TR) Routing**——一种 tile-aware 的路由方法：在 token-choice top-K 路由结果基础上，将每个 expert 接收的 token 数 f_e 舍入到 GEMM tile size M_tile（默认128）的最近倍数。算法两阶段：(a) 计算 top-K TC 结果；(b) 构建 EC 排序分数 S'（TC 选中 token 保持原分数，未选中减1确保 TC token 优先），对每个 expert 从 S' 按分数排序选择 tile-rounded 数量的 token。round_and_sparsify 子例程决定 padding（选择额外 EC tokens）或 discarding（丢弃最后 TC tile 的 tokens），每个 expert 偏离 TC 结果最多 1 tile。TR 保证期望总 token 数不变但消除 Grouped GEMM padding 浪费。
  - 实验比较：(a) **Activation Memory**：SonicMoE vs ScatterMoE/MoMoE/MegaBlocks/DeepGEMM，在 1.4B~120B MoE 配置下 per-layer peak memory，SonicMoE 减少 20%~159%；(b) **Forward/Backward TFLOPS**：SonicMoE vs all baselines，7B MoE (n=256) 上 forward TFLOPS +43% vs DeepGEMM，backward +83% vs ScatterMoE, +115% vs MoMoE；(c) **Token Rounding 质量**：TR vs TC top-K vs EC vs TC(token drop) 在 0.5B/1.4B/1.8B MoE 上的 train/val PPL 和 11 个下游任务 accuracy（Wino/SIQA/SciQ/PIQA/OBQA/HS/COPA/CSQA/BoolQ/ArcE/ArcC）；(d) **TR 训练吞吐**：TR vs TC top-K 在稀疏 MoE 配置下的 MoE kernel TFLOPS；(e) **TR Ablation**：rounding subroutine (NR-f/SR-f/NR-s/Balance-f/UP/DOWN)、microbatch size T、tile size M_tile 对模型质量的影响；(f) **Expert Granularity 影响**：iso-FLOPs 下 n=1024/256/64 的 MoE 质量对比。

- 硬件平台是什么，配置是什么。
  - GPU：NVIDIA H100-80GB (Hopper, SM90) 和 NVIDIA B300 (Blackwell, SM100)
  - 多节点训练：64× H100（FSDP-2 + ZeRO-3 node-internal sharding）
  - 软件：CuTe-DSL kernel + PyTorch 接口 + lm-engine 代码库

- 模型是什么。数据集和bench分别是什么。
  - TR 训练模型：0.5B MoE（8/64 activated）、1.4B MoE（8/128 activated）、1.8B MoE（8/256 activated），基于 OLMoE 架构
  - 训练数据集：去重版 FineWeb-Edu
  - 评估 Benchmark：WinoGrande、SIQA、SciQ、PIQA、OpenBookQA、HellaSwag、COPA、CommonsenseQA、BoolQ、Arc-Easy、Arc-Challenge（共 11 个下游任务），报告 PPL 和 accuracy
  - Kernel 性能 benchmark：各种 MoE 配置（7B n=256/512/1024, 30B, 120B），以及 OLMoE-1B-7B/gpt-oss-20b/Kimi-Linear/Qwen3-Next-80B/Qwen3-235B/DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp 的实际开源模型配置

- 开源情况。基于开源文档和论文，使用例子解释，解释算法pipeline，至少具体到伪代码或张量计算。
  - 开源：GitHub https://github.com/Dao-AILab/sonic-moe（permissive license），ICLR'26 论文
  - 算法 Pipeline（Memory-efficient Backward）：
    ```
    # Forward（与传统 MoE 相同，但缓存策略不同）
    For each expert e in [E]:
      X_e = Gather(X, π_{:,e})                    # [T_e, d], fused with HBM load
      H_e = X_e W_{1,e}                           # [T_e, 2n], cached for backward
      A_e = SwiGLU(H_e)                           # [T_e, n]
      Y_e = A_e W_{2,e}                           # [T_e, d], NOT cached!
    O_t = Σ_e π_{t,e} S_{t,e} Y_{e,t}             # [T, d], token aggregation
    
    # Backward（SonicMoE 关键优化——不缓存 Y, X_e, dO_e）
    # dH kernel: 计算 dH, dS, A' 三个输出
    For each expert e in [E]:
      dO_e = Gather(dO, π_{:,e})                  # fused with HBM load
      dA'_e = dO_e W_{2,e}^T                      # [T_e, n]
      s_e = Gather(S, π_{:,e})
      dA_e = Broadcast(s_e) * dA'_e              # 替代 dA = dY W_2^T
      A_e, dH_e = dSwiGLU(dA_e, H_e)             # 从 H 重算 A
      A'_e = Broadcast(s_e) * A_e                 # [T_e, n], 输入给 dW2
      dS_{e,t} = ⟨dA'_{e,t}, A_{e,t}⟩            # reduce over n, 替代 ⟨dO, Y⟩
    
    # dW2 kernel: 使用 A' 而非 A
    For each expert e in [E]:
      dO_e = Gather(dO, π_{:,e})
      dW_{2,e} = A'_e^T dO_e                     # 等价于 A_e^T dY_e
    
    # 激活缓存大小分析:
    # SonicMoE: cache X [T×d] + H [TK×2n] + π [TK×E bits] + S [TK] = 2Td + 4TKn bytes
    # ScatterMoE: 额外 cache Y [TK×d] + X_e [TK×d] = 2Td + 4TKn + 2TKd bytes
    # 当 n=d/G 时，SonicMoE 节省 2TKd bytes，与 G 无关
    ```
  - Token Rounding 算法：
    ```
    # Algorithm 4: Token Rounding Routing
    Input: X ∈ R^{T×d}, E experts, K activated, tile size M_tile, router scores S
    Output: M_tile-rounded routed tokens π' and scores s'
    
    Step 1: (S_topK, I_topK) = TopK(S, K)                  # vanilla top-K TC
    Step 2: f_e = Σ_t 1_{e ∈ I_topK(t)}                   # per-expert frequency
            [f_e]_{M_tile}^{up} = ⌈f_e/M_tile⌉ · M_tile
            [f_e]_{M_tile}^{down} = ⌊f_e/M_tile⌋ · M_tile
    Step 3: S' = S; S'(t, non-topK) = S(t, non-topK) - 1  # TC tokens preferred
    Step 4: For each expert e:
              Sort S'_e descending → ranked token list
              Decide round_up or round_down via round_and_sparsify
              If round_up: select first ⌈f_e⌉_{M_tile} tokens from ranked S'_e
              If round_down: select first ⌊f_e⌋_{M_tile} tokens from ranked S'_e
    ```

## Self-MoE Towards Compositional Large Language Models with Self-Specialized Experts

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：Self-MoE——将单体LLM转化为由自专业化专家组成的组合式模块化系统MiXSE（MiXture of Self-specialized Experts）。核心包括两阶段：(1) **Self-Specialization**：对每个目标领域（知识/推理/数学/编程），用100条种子数据提示base LLM进行Instruction Brainstorming生成多样化指令，再生成对应回复，产生5K条自生成合成数据 D_i，然后用LoRA（rank=8, alpha=16）在 D_i 上微调base LLM得到轻量专家模块 ΔΘ_i（每个模块仅占base模型参数的<0.3%）；(2) **MiXSE集成**：将所有专家模块与共享base LLM组合，引入一个可学习的线性路由层 θ_r（softmax + top-k），对每层输入的token x 计算路由权重 α = top-k(softmax(θ_r x))，输出 h = θ_0 x + Σ α_i Δθ_i x，仅用聚合的合成数据 D = ∪D_i 训练路由层而冻结所有专家模块，保持专家的语义区分性。总参数量仅增加约1%。
  - 实验比较：(a) 主实验：MiXSE vs Base LLM (Gemma-7B) vs 4个单独Self-Specialized模型 vs Instance Merging vs TIES Merging vs DARE Merging，在MMLU/BBH/GSM8K/HumanEval四个目标benchmark上，所有方法使用相同的活跃参数量(7B+0.3%)；(b) 消融实验：Top-1/Top-2/All Experts路由策略、Random Routing（无自优化路由器）、Experts & Router Joint Training（无语义区分）；(c) 路由分析：可视化路由分布验证专家-任务匹配；(d) 泛化与遗忘测试：在非目标benchmark（MATH/MBPP/NQ/TriviaQA/Hellaswag/PIQA/TruthfulQA）上评估；(e) 多base LLM适用性：LLaMA-2 7B&13B, Mistral 7B, LLaMA-3 8B；(f) 合成数据量扩展分析（0→20K）；(g) 专家数量扩展（1→4，逐步添加K/R/M/C专家）；(h) Seed Only对比验证合成数据的增益。

    # Phase 1: Self-Specialization — 为每个目标领域 T_i 构建专家模块
    For each target domain T_i in {knowledge, reasoning, math, coding}:
      # Step A: 种子构造
      seeds_i = sample_100_examples(T_i)  # 从MMLU/BBH/GSM8K/MBPP采样
      
      # Step B: Instruction Brainstorming
      D_i = []
      For each batch of 3 seeds as in-context examples:
        prompt = BRAINSTORM_PROMPT(T_i) + in_context_seeds
        new_instructions = Θ_0.generate(prompt, temp=1.0, top_p=0.98)
        D_i.add_instructions(new_instructions)
      
      # Step C: Response Generation
      For each instruction in D_i:
        prompt = RESPONSE_PROMPT(T_i) + 5_seed_pairs + instruction
        response = Θ_0.generate(prompt, greedy=True)
        D_i.add_response(instruction, response)
      
      # Step D: LoRA Self-Alignment
      ΔΘ_i = LoRA(rank=8, alpha=16)  # 应用于所有层
      For epoch in 1..3:
        For batch in D_i (batch_size=32):
          h = θ_0 @ x + θ_B_i @ θ_A_i @ x  # θ_B_i ∈ R^{d×8}, θ_A_i ∈ R^{8×k}
          loss = CrossEntropy(h, target)
          ΔΘ_i = AdamW(lr=3e-4).step(loss)  # 仅更新LoRA参数
    
    # Phase 2: MiXSE — 路由器学习组合专家
    θ_r = Linear(k, n)  # n=4 个专家，共享于所有LoRA层
    D = ∪ D_i  # 聚合所有合成数据
    
    For batch (inst, resp) in D:
      For each layer with LoRA:
        # Token级路由
        For each token x in input sequence:
          logits = θ_r @ x           # [n] 每个专家的原始分数
          α = softmax(logits)        # [n] 概率分布
          α = top_k(α, k=1)         # 仅保留top-k，其余mask为0
          # 加权组合专家输出
          h = θ_0 @ x + Σ_{i=1..n} α_i * (θ_B_i @ θ_A_i @ x)
      loss = -log P(resp | inst; θ_r, {ΔΘ_i})
    θ_r = AdamW(lr).step(loss)  # 仅更新路由器，冻结所有专家模块
    
    # Inference: 共享base θ_0 + 动态激活top-k LoRA专家
    ```

## Scaling Beyond the GPU Memory Limit for Large Mixture-of-Experts Model Training

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：ES-MoE——一种面向大规模MoE模型训练的可扩展系统，核心机制包括：(1) **Expert-wise offloading**：将expert参数和optimizer state卸载到CPU内存/SSD，仅保留non-expert参数、当前使用中expert的参数及激活值在GPU显存中，突破GPU内存限制；(2) **Pipelined expert processing**：在token permutation阶段重叠第1个expert的CPU→GPU上传，后续expert顺序处理时重叠前一个expert计算与下一个expert上传，最大化GPU利用率；(3) **Expert-wise CPU optimization**：每个expert完成backward pass后即刻触发CPU optimizer更新，而非等待整个layer完成，使layers靠近output的优化被layers靠近input的GPU计算隐藏；(4) **Sequential expert computation**（非batched matrix multiplication）：避免创建大的dispatch mask，节省显存以支持更大microbatch；(5) **Dynamic expert placement**：采用greedy scheduling（minimizing makespan的4/3-approximation算法），按token负载将experts动态分配给各GPU，消除zero-padding；(6) **Adaptive offloading**：根据模型能否放入聚合GPU内存自动选择三种模式：GPU only / CPU offload + expert pinning / CPU+SSD offload。基于Fairseq实现，采用DeepSpeed的CPU Adam optimizer，共3300行Python + 3000行C++代码。
  - 实验比较：(a) 训练吞吐量比较：ES-MoE vs Zero-Offload^E vs FairSeq vs Tutel，在MoE-S/M/L不同expert数量(8/16/32/64)下；(b) 可扩展性：各框架在4 GPU下能支持的最大expert数量及model size；(c) microbatch size变化对吞吐量的影响（MoE-M 16 experts）；(d) ablation study：逐项消除expert pinning/optimizer overlap/larger batch/zero-padding elimination的影响；(e) LLM fine-tuning：Fairseq-MoE-15B在SST-2/MNLI/BoolQ数据集上用4 GPU fine-tune 100M tokens的准确率；(f) GPU utilization对比（ES-MoE vs Zero-Offload^E，不同expert数量下）

    # ES-MoE Training Step (single MoE layer, K GPUs)
    
    # Input: tokens (batch_size, seq_len, d_model)
    # Experts E_0...E_{m-1}, each has its parameters on CPU
    
    # === Forward Pass ===
    # Step 1: Gating network (on GPU)
    gate_logits = gating_network(tokens)       # (batch, seq, num_experts)
    expert_ids = argmax(gate_logits, dim=-1)   # top-1 routing
    
    # Step 2: Dynamic Expert Placement (on CPU)
    # Count tokens per expert: load[e_0], load[e_1], ..., load[e_{m-1}]
    # Greedy scheduling: sort experts by load descending
    # Assign each expert to GPU with minimum accumulated load
    # Result: GPU_i gets experts {e_i0, e_i1, ...}, GPU load balanced
    
    # Step 3: Token Permutation (overlapped w/ 1st expert upload)
    exchange_tokens_across_GPUs(tokens, expert_ids)  # all-to-all
    # Simultaneously: async upload 1st expert per GPU (CPU→GPU)
    
    # Step 4: Pipelined Expert Processing (sequential per GPU)
    for expert_e in GPU_i's assigned experts:          # PIPELINE:
        if not first_expert:
            wait_for(previous_expert_compute_done)     # sync
        # Expert forward computation on GPU
        output_e = expert_e.forward(input_tokens_e)    # ffn computation
        # (next expert is already uploading during this computation)
        async_upload_next_expert()                     # CPU→GPU copy
    
    # Step 5: Token Un-permutation
    tokens = inverse_exchange(outputs)
    tokens = weighted_sum(tokens, gate_logits)  # combine expert outputs
    
    # === Backward Pass (reverse order) ===
    # Similar pipeline: expert computation on GPU overlapped w/ upload
    
    # === Expert-wise CPU Optimizer (overlapped w/ backward) ===
    # Each expert, as soon as its backward completes:
    for expert_e in completed_experts:           # STREAMING:
        grad_e = expert_e.grad                   # on GPU
        # CPU optimizer step
        cpu_adam_step(expert_e.params, grad_e, expert_e.opt_state)
        # Expert params + opt state stay on CPU (offloaded)
        # Next layer's backward runs concurrently on GPU
    
    # Adaptive Offloading modes:
    if all_experts_fit_in_GPU_memory:
        mode = GPU_ONLY                # no offload, still sequential processing
    elif all_experts_fit_in_CPU_memory:
        mode = CPU_OFFLOAD             # offload to host memory
        pin_top_25pct_experts()        # expert pinning optimization
    else:
        mode = CPU_SSD_OFFLOAD         # LRU cache + prefetch via pinned DMA
    ```
  - 关键张量计算等价性：ES-MoE的sequential expert computation与batched matrix multiplication在数学上完全等价。每个token只经过其被路由到的expert的FFN计算：`output[e] = W_down[e] @ SiLU(W_gate[e] @ x) * W_up[e] @ x`。ES-MoE通过避免创建dispatch mask（大小为(num_padded_tokens, num_tokens)的稀疏矩阵）来节省内存，改为直接按gating结果顺序分配token到对应expert。

## Samoyeds: Accelerating MoE Models with Structured Sparsity Leveraging Sparse Tensor Cores

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：提出一种面向MoE计算的**双端结构化稀疏数据格式（N:M:V）**。权重端采用两层稀疏：(1) 2:4 element-wise稀疏对齐SpTC的ISA要求（50% sparse ratio，每个连续4元素保留2个非零值）；(2) vector-wise稀疏（Sub-Row level），权重划分为 $M \times V$ 的块，每块内仅保留N个Sub-Row，提供灵活稀疏比（可超50%）。激活端采用vector-wise稀疏，通过SEL（selection array）记录token routing后的有效列。原始权重编码为三部分：data矩阵（压缩后的非零值，shape $\frac{m}{M} \times \frac{k}{2}$）、indices矩阵（记录保留Sub-Row的位置，shape $\frac{m}{M} \times \frac{k}{V}$）、metadata矩阵（每SpTC单元的2-bit稀疏模式，shape $\frac{m}{M} \times \frac{k}{2}$）。剪枝过程与推理解耦，可集成SOTA剪枝方法（WoodFisher/SparseGPT），使用SparseML框架的WoodFisher方法。
  - 实验比较：(a) 不同(N,M,V)稀疏配置下BERT-base/large的F1 Score（SQuAD 1.1）；(b) Tiny-LLaMA-1B和Qwen2-1.5B在不同格式下（Dense/Unstructured/VENOM/Samoyeds）的Perplexity（GSM8K）；(c) 统一75% sparsity ratio。

    ```
    # 离线阶段：权重编码
    For each weight matrix W of shape (m, k):
      # Step 1: 分块
      Divide W into blocks of size M × V
      # Step 2: Sub-Row selection（vector-wise稀疏）
      For each block:
        Retain N out of M Sub-Rows (based on importance, e.g. WoodFisher)
        Record indices of retained Sub-Rows
      # Step 3: 2:4 element-wise稀疏（在每个保留Sub-Row内）
      For each 4-element group in retained Sub-Rows:
        Keep 2 out of 4 elements (largest magnitude)
        Encode 2-bit metadata for position
      # Step 4: 压缩存储
      data = concatenate all kept elements → shape (m/M * N, k/2)
      metadata = 2-bit positions per 4-element group → shape (m/M * N, k/2)
      indices = relative positions of retained Sub-Rows → shape (m/M, k/V)
    
    # 在线推理阶段：稀疏-稀疏矩阵乘法
    Input: tokens I, router scores R
    # Step 1: Token routing → 生成SEL（每个expert处理哪些token）
    For each expert E_i:
      SEL[i] = indices of tokens routed to expert E_i
    # Step 2: 稀疏-稀疏GEMM（Samoyeds kernel）
    For each expert E_i:
      A = encoded weight (data, indices, metadata)
      B = input[SEL[i]]  # 仅加载被路由的token
      C = Samoyeds_sparse_mm(A, B)  # 使用mma.sp指令
      # Kernel内部：3-step tiling + data stationary + packing + pipeline
    # Step 3: Weighted accumulation（fused inside kernel）
    output = sum(C_i * router_score_i)
    ```

## ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：(1) **router z-loss**：新增辅助损失函数 $L_z(x) = \frac{1}{B} \sum_{i=1}^{B} \left( \log \sum_{j=1}^{N} e^{x_j^{(i)}} \right)^2$，惩罚路由器 logits 的大值，稳定训练而不损害模型质量，系数 $c_z=0.001$，总损失 $L_{tot} = L_{CE} + c_B L_B + c_z L_Z$；(2) **微调协议优化**：发现稀疏模型需更小 batch size、更高学习率的微调超参数设置，提出仅微调非 MoE 参数子集以对抗过拟合；(3) **架构设计原则**：sparse-dense stacking（每 MoE 层前后各加一个 dense FFN）、multiplicative bias（expert 层中加逐元素乘性偏置）、top-n routing with capacity factor 优化；(4) Batch Prioritized Routing (BPR) 用于低 capacity factor 场景。
  - 实验比较：(a) 多种训练稳定技术（移除 GEGLU、移除 RMS scale param、input jitter、dropout、update clipping、router z-loss）比较 fraction stable 和 neg log perplexity；(b) top-1/top-2/top-3 routing + 不同 capacity factor 组合的 perplexity 比较；(c) 密集 vs 稀疏模型的微调超参数敏感性（batch size × learning rate）；(d) ST-MoE-32B 在 SuperGLUE、SQuAD、XSum、CNN-DM、ARC、ANLI、Winogrande、Closed-book QA 上的 SOTA 比较；(e) 微调时不同参数子集（All/Non MoE/MoE/Attention/FFN）的质量比较；(f) 不同 capacity factor + aux loss 下 token dropping 对微调质量的影响。

    ```
    # Router z-loss computation
    def router_z_loss(router_logits):
      # router_logits: [B, N] where B=batch tokens, N=num_experts
      z_loss = tf.reduce_mean(tf.square(
        tf.reduce_logsumexp(router_logits, axis=-1)
      ))
      return z_loss

    # Total loss
    total_loss = cross_entropy_loss + c_B * load_balance_loss + c_z * router_z_loss
    # c_z = 0.001, c_B = 0.01 (aux load balance coefficient alpha)

    # Top-n routing with capacity factor
    def top_n_routing(token_embeddings, router_weights, capacity_factor, n=2):
      # Step 1: compute router logits
      router_logits = einsum('bd,dn->bn', token_embeddings, router_weights)
      # Step 2: select top-n experts per token
      top_n_gates, top_n_indices = top_k(softmax(router_logits), k=n)
      # Step 3: normalize gate values for top-n
      top_n_gates = top_n_gates / sum(top_n_gates, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
      # Step 4: relative threshold routing (threshold=0.2)
      for i in range(1, n):  # for 2nd..nth expert
        mask = top_n_gates[:, i] < threshold
        rand = tf.random.uniform(shape=mask.shape)
        route_mask = tf.logical_or(
          tf.logical_not(mask),
          rand < (top_n_gates[:, i] / threshold)
        )
      # Step 5: capacity-based token dropping
      expert_capacity = capacity_factor * tokens_per_group / num_experts
      for expert_id in range(num_experts):
        expert_tokens = tokens_routed_to(expert_id)
        if len(expert_tokens) > expert_capacity:
          drop tokens exceeding capacity (left-to-right order)
      # Step 6: expert computation (GEGLU FFN)
      for each expert:
        output = (GELU(x @ W_11) * (x @ W_12)) @ W_2
      # Step 7: combine expert outputs weighted by gate values
      final_output = sum(gate_i * expert_output_i for i in top_n_indices)

    # Sparse-Dense Stacking
    for each attention layer:
      if is_sparse_layer:
        output = DenseFFN(x)           # dense FFN before MoE
        output = MoE_Layer(output)      # sparse MoE
        output = DenseFFN(output)       # dense FFN after MoE
      else:
        output = DenseFFN(x)
    
    # Multiplicative Bias in Expert FFN
    def FFN_GEGLU_MultBias(x):
      # B is learnable multiplicative bias, initialized to ones
      return [(GELU(x @ W_11) * (x @ W_12)) * B] @ W_2
    ```

## S'MoRE: Structural Mixture of Residual Experts for LLM Fine-tuning

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：**S'MoRE** 是一个层次化结构式残差专家混合（Structural Mixture of Residual Experts）PEFT adapter 框架。核心设计：(1) **层次化低秩残差分解**：将每个 expert 的权重矩阵分解为多阶残差项的和 $W^i \approx \sum_{\ell=0}^{L-1} B^i_\ell \cdot A^i_\ell$，其中每阶残差 $B^i_\ell \cdot A^i_\ell$ 为低秩矩阵（秩 $r_\ell$），各阶残差排列为 L 层结构。(2) **树形路由（Hierarchical Routing）**：路由器自顶向下（从层 L 到层 1）逐层选择子节点 expert，对每个父节点 expert i，计算条件概率 $p(i_{\ell-1} \mid i_{L-1}, \dots, i_\ell, x)$，选择 top-$f_{\ell-1}$ 子节点，形成深度为 L 的激活树。(3) **自底向上聚合传播**：token 沿激活树从层 1 到层 L 传播，每层 $\ell+1$ 执行 $x_{\ell+1}^i = \sum_{n \in \mathcal{N}_\ell^i} \alpha_\ell^{i,n} \cdot \sigma(B_\ell^n \cdot A_\ell^n \cdot x + W_\ell \cdot x_\ell^n)$，其中 $\sigma$ 为非线性激活（ReLU 等），$W_\ell$ 为层间投影矩阵。最终输出经 $W_{\text{proj}} \in \mathbb{R}^{d_L \times d}$ 投影回原维度。(4) **维度设计**：中间层输出维度 $d_{\ell+1} = d_\ell + s_\ell \cdot r_\ell$，保证无信息损失且计算高效，总参数量近似 $2 \cdot d \cdot d_L$，与 vanilla LoRA（rank $d_L$）相同。(5) **路由器实现**：每个 expert i 有一个可学习的 key vector $k_\ell^i \in \mathbb{R}^m$，MLP 根据 token embedding x 和祖先 key vectors 生成 query vector q，路由概率 $\alpha_\ell^i = \text{softmax}(\langle k_\ell^i, q \rangle)$。先将 x 投影到低维 $x_{\text{down}}$（如 d=4096, $d_{\text{down}}=24$）再输入 MLP 以减少计算。
  - 实验比较：(1) **S'MoRE vs LoRA vs MixLoRA vs HydraLoRA**，在相同可训练参数量预算下比较 accuracy/Pass@1；(2) 三种 gate 类型对比：Dense gate（激活所有子专家）、Sparse noisy top-k gate、Sparse switch-transformer gate；(3) 在 3 种基座模型（LLaMA 3.2-1B、LLaMA 3-8B、Gemma 2-9B）上评估；(4) 层数 scaling 实验（2层 vs 3层）；(5) 参数-准确率 scaling 行为分析。

  ```
  # === S'MoRE Forward Pass for token x (d-dim) ===

  # 阶段1: 自顶向下路由 (Top-Down Routing)
  x_down = W_down @ x          # [d_down], d_down << d (e.g., 24)

  # Layer 2 路由 (选择顶层 experts)
  q_1 = MLP_1(x_down)          # [m]
  scores_1 = softmax(K_1 @ q_1)  # [s_1], K_1 shape [s_1, m], s_1=4
  activated_L2 = top_k(scores_1, k=f_1)  # 选择 f_1=2 个顶层 experts

  # Layer 1 路由 (为每个顶层 expert 选择子节点)
  for each parent p in activated_L2:
      q_0 = MLP_0(concat(x_down, k_1^p))  # [m], 条件于父节点
      scores_0 = softmax(K_0 @ q_0)        # [s_0], s_0=4
      children[p] = top_k(scores_0, k=f_0) # 每个父节点选 f_0=2 子节点

  # 阶段2: 自底向上聚合 (Bottom-Up Aggregation)
  # Layer 1 聚合
  d_1 = s_0 * r_0  # 输出维度, e.g., 4*8=32
  for each parent p:
      x_1^p = zeros(d_1)
      for each child n in children[p]:
          # B_0^n: [d_1, r_0], A_0^n: [r_0, d]
          x_1^p += alpha_0^{p,n} * ReLU(B_0^n @ A_0^n @ x + W_0 @ x_0^n)
          # x_0^n 不存在于第1层 (d_0=0)

  # Layer 2 聚合 (最终输出)
  d_2 = d_1 + s_1 * r_1  # 输出维度, e.g., 32+4*8=64
  x_2 = zeros(d_2)
  for each activated top expert i:
      for each child n of i:
          x_2 += alpha_1^{i,n} * ReLU(B_1^n @ A_1^n @ x + W_1 @ x_1^{i->n})

  # 最终投影
  x' = W_proj @ x_2  # [d], W_proj shape [d, d_2]

  # Adapter 输出加回预训练权重输出
  output = frozen_pretrained(x) + x'
  ```
  - 参数效率：总可训练参数 $\approx 2 \cdot d \cdot d_L$，与 rank=$d_L$ 的 vanilla LoRA 相同。例如 d=4096, $d_L$=64 时约 0.5M 参数。多层层间投影开销 $\Delta = \sum d_\ell^2$ 在实践中 < 2%。
  - 计算效率：总计算量 $\approx 2 \cdot d \cdot d_L$，router 开销相对于 expert 传播最多 26%。

## Remoe: Towards Efficient and Low-Cost MoE Inference in Serverless Computing

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：**SPS（Similar Prompts Searching）算法**用于 prompt 级 expert 激活分布预测。核心流程：(1) **离线阶段**：对所有历史 prompt 计算 pairwise Soft Cosine Similarity (SCS)，构建多叉聚类树。节点（cluster）超过 β 个 prompt 时递归划分，使用定制 k-medoids 聚类（roulette wheel sampling 初始化质心，subcluster 级质心更新），距离度量为 SCS。α < β 以支持 leaf 内局部暴力搜索。(2) **在线预测**：新 prompt 遍历聚类树到 leaf，若 leaf 内样本不足 α，回退到 sibling nodes 补充。对检索到的 α 个历史 prompt，将其 SCS 值经 softmax 转为概率权重，加权求和其 expert 激活分布矩阵得到预测结果。(3) **SCS 计算**：对两个 prompt ζ1, ζ2，归一化并拼接 token embedding 矩阵，乘以其转置得到对称 token 相似度矩阵 C_{ζ1,ζ2}，构造 alignment vectors V1, V2（binary 标记 token 归属），SCS = (V1^T C V2) / (√(V1^T C V1) * √(V2^T C V2) + σ)。
  - 实验比较：(1) **SPS vs 6个baseline**：VarPAM（替换 k-medoids 为 PAM 聚类）、VarED（替换距离度量为 expert 激活分布的 Euclidean 距离）、DOP（直接用历史激活作为预测）、Fate（用前一层的 hidden states 预测，调整为用初始 prompt embedding 预测所有层）、EF（假设所有 expert 激活频率相等）、BF（暴力搜索 top-α 语义相似 prompt）；(2) 在 **LMSYS-Chat-1M、WikiText-2、C4、SlimPajama** 四个数据集上对比 JS Divergence（预测 vs 真实 expert 激活分布），5000 train + 500 test samples；(3) 聚类树构建时间对比（SPS ≤ 0.5s vs VarPAM 需数小时），搜索速度对比（SPS 比 BF 快 10 倍以上）。

## Prediction Is All MoE Needs: Expert Load Distribution Goes from Fluctuating to Stabilizing

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：基于 MoE 模型训练过程中 expert 负载的时序特征分析，部署三种经典预测算法（LSTM-based、ARIMA-based、Sliding Window Average-based）对 expert 负载分布进行高精度预测。核心设计分为两阶段：(1) 通过大量训练实验追踪 GPT-3 125M 和 GPT-3 350M 在不同滑动窗口（10/100/200）下的 expert 负载方差（variance）和极差（range），定义 transient state（早期训练迭代中负载显著波动）和 stable state（经过一定迭代后负载呈现 temporal locality，相邻迭代间变化小）；(2) 针对两种状态的特征，部署三种预测算法：LSTM-based 以所有 expert 在各 MoE 层的历史负载比例作为输入，输出未来 k 步的负载比例值；ARIMA-based 对每条 expert 负载时间序列执行平稳性和季节性检验以选择 (p,d,q) 参数，一般形式为 (1-ΣφᵢLⁱ)(1-L)ᵈX_t = (1+ΣθⱼLʲ)ε_t；SW Avg-based 直接取历史多轮负载比例的算术平均作为下一轮预测值，通过 k 轮滑动计算预测未来负载。
  - 实验比较：(1) LSTM-based vs ARIMA-based vs SW Avg-based 在 GPT-3 125M 和 GPT-3 350M 上对比预测误差率，评估指标为各 MoE 层 expert 负载比例的滑动预测均值误差率；(2) 三种算法在 transient state（early iterations）和 stable state（after ~5,000 iterations）的误差率变化趋势对比；(3) 短期预测（1,000 iterations）和长期预测（2,000 iterations）的算法性能差异；(4) SW Avg-based 作为硬件友好型方法的计算效率分析。

  - 算法 pipeline 核心流程：
    - **Phase 1: 负载数据采集与状态分析**
      对每个训练 iteration t，记录 MoE layer l 中 expert i 的负载比例 n_i^l(t) = tokens_processed_by_expert_i / total_tokens_in_layer。设定滑动窗口大小 w（10/100/200），计算窗口内各 expert 负载的方差 variance_i = Var(n_i^l(t) ... n_i^l(t-w+1)) 和极差 range_i = max - min，通过方差和极差的时序变化识别 transient → stable 状态转换。以 GPT-3 125M 为例，~5,000 iterations 后进入 stable state。
    - **Phase 2: LSTM-based 预测**
      输入：历史 expert 负载数据 [n_1^1, n_2^1, ..., n_1^2, n_2^2, ..., n_e^m]（将所有 MoE 层所有 expert 的历史负载数据展平为一维向量），其中 n_j^i 表示第 i 个 MoE 层中第 j 个 expert 的负载比例历史序列。输出：所有 expert 在未来 k 次 iteration 的负载比例值。LSTM 模型学习 expert 负载的时序变化模式，两次独立训练数据分别作为 train/test set。
    - **Phase 3: ARIMA-based 预测**
      对每个 expert 的时间序列数据 n_i^l(t)，执行平稳性检验（判断 d 差分阶数）和季节性检验（判断 p 自回归阶数、q 移动平均阶数）。具体参数：ARIMA(5,1,5) 即 p=5, d=1, q=5。模型形式：(1-L)X_t = (1+θ₁L+θ₂L²+θ₃L³+θ₄L⁴+θ₅L⁵)/(1-φ₁L-φ₂L²-φ₃L³-φ₄L⁴-φ₅L⁵) · ε_t。目标是最小化预测误差以获取准确未来预测。
    - **Phase 4: SW Avg-based 预测**
      最简方法：predicted_load_i = (1/w) Σ_{j=t-w+1}^{t} n_i(j)，即取最近 w 轮历史数据的算术平均作为下一轮预测值。对未来 k 轮迭代，每轮使用最新的预测结果作为下一轮的历史数据输入（即滚动预测）。该方法计算效率极高，对硬件友好。
    - **关键结果**：GPT-3 125M stable state——LSTM 误差率 <1%, ARIMA ~0.5%, SW Avg ~0.25%；GPT-3 350M stable state (1,000-step prediction)——LSTM <10%, ARIMA ~1.4%, SW Avg ~1.3%；(2,000-step prediction)——SW Avg ~1.7%。SW Avg 在三种算法中表现最佳，且在 transient state（前 5,000 iterations）误差率逐步下降。
    - **应用价值**：预测结果可为 expert placement（如 FlexMoE 的启发式算法）或 resource allocation 提供指导——stable state 下可基于预测进行细粒度资源分配，transient state 下则需预留充足资源应对负载爆发。

## Read-ME: Refactorizing LLMs as Router-Decoupled Mixture of Experts with System Co-Design

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：将预训练 dense LLM（Llama2-7B-chat）通过 activation sparsity **refactorize** 为更小的 MoE 模型（4.7B activated / 17B total）。核心算法 pipeline 分三步：(1) **Domain-Aware Expert Construction**：利用训练语料元数据将语料分为 N 个子域（Arxiv, Books, C4, Common Crawl, Github, Wikipedia, StackExchange），对每个子域 D_i 计算特征通道的平均激活幅度（activation magnitude），通过结构化 pruning 保留 top-activated 神经元构造 domain expert。形式化为选择矩阵 M_i ∈ {0,1}^{d×D}（d≈D/2），最大化 E[||M_i W_1 x||_1]。(2) **Pre-Gating Router**：提出单层 Transformer block（1-layer, 4-head, 18M params, SwiGLU FFN, RoPE, RMSNorm）作为跨所有 layer 共享的 router，替代传统逐层 router。Router 以 causal attention 方式考虑当前及历史 token 信息进行 expert 选择，消除逐层 router 的冗余。(3) **Continual Training with Routing Distillation Loss**：随机初始化 router，冻结 expert 先优化 router 100 steps（L_RD = KL(softmax(G(x)) || softmax([||M_0 M_1^T||_F^2, ...]))），后冻结 router 优化 expert 200 steps（language modeling loss），迭代 8 rounds。总共仅用 1.04B tokens（vs Llama2 预训练 2T tokens）。额外设计 permanent expert 处理所有 token 共享的知识。
  - 实验比较：(1) **下游任务对比**：Read-ME vs Pythia (2.8B, 6.9B)、Open-Llama-v2 (3.4B, 6.9B)、OpenMoE (2.1B-8B)、Sheared-Llama (2.7B)，在 MMLU (5-shot)、HellaSwag (10-shot)、WinoGrande、ARC-Easy、ARC-Challenge (25-shot)、LogiQA、CoQA 上评估；(2) **压缩方法对比**：Read-ME vs LLM-Pruner、SliceGPT、LaCo、Compresso、Sheared-Llama，在 MMLU 上对比 activation params vs accuracy；(3) **MoE vs Dense 结构对比**：相同数据量下对比 refactorize 为 MoE vs 同等大小 dense 模型，评估 MMLU 和 7 域 perplexity；(4) **Mistral 底座泛化**：用 Mistral-7B 作底座 refactorize，验证方法在没有训练域先验知识下的有效性；(5) **Router 计算开销**：Traditional Router vs Auto-regressive Router 的 FLOPs、latency 对比（batch size 5/10/20/30）。

    - **Phase 1: Domain-Aware Expert Construction（结构化 pruning 初始化 expert）**
      输入：预训练 dense LLM FFN 权重 W_1 ∈ R^{D×h}, W_2 ∈ R^{h×D}, 子域数据集 {D_1,...,D_N}。
      对每个子域 D_i：
      1. 前向传播：对 D_i 中样本 x，计算中间激活 a = W_1 x ∈ R^D。
      2. 计算通道平均激活幅度：ā = E_{x~D_i}[|a|] ∈ R^D。
      3. 选择 top-d 个最大激活通道：构造选择矩阵 M_i ∈ {0,1}^{d×D}，满足 M_i 1_D = 1（每行选一个通道），M_i^T 1_d ≤ 1（每列最多被选一次），最大化 E[||M_i W_1 x||_1]。
      4. 初始化 expert i：F_i(x) = W_2 M_i^T σ(M_i W_1 x)，其中 d ≈ D/2。
      5. 识别所有数据共享激活的通道 → 构造 permanent expert（对所有 token 激活）。
      - 分层对齐：对所有 layer 联合优化 mask，确保同一 domain 在不同 layer 选择相同索引的 expert。
    - **Phase 2: Continual Training（8 rounds 交替优化）**
      Router Tuning Stage（100 steps/round, batch_size=64, seq_len=4096, LR=5e-4 cosine decay）：
      - 冻结所有 expert 权重。
      - 前向计算：router G 接受 x_{≤t}（含 causal attention），输出 gating weights G(x_{≤t}) ∈ R^N。
      - 路由蒸馏损失：对 predicted token x_{t+1} 喂入原始 dense 模型，计算 top-50% magnitude mask M_0。L_RD = KL(softmax(G(x_{≤t+1})) || softmax([||M_0 M_1^T||_F^2, ..., ||M_0 M_N^T||_F^2]))。此损失鼓励 router 选择与 dense 模型激活稀疏模式一致的 expert。
      - 优化 router 参数。
      Expert Tuning Stage（200 steps/round, batch_size=128, seq_len=4096, LR=5e-5 cosine decay）：
      - 冻结 router 权重。
      - 对每个 token x_t，router 输出 top-K expert 索引（K=2 + permanent expert）。
      - 仅计算选中 expert 的 FFN 输出：y_t = Σ_{i: selected} G(x_{≤t})_i · F_i^{(l)}(x_t)。
      - 优化 expert 权重（language modeling cross-entropy loss）。
      - LR 跨 round 指数衰减（decay rate 0.8, weight decay 0.01）。
      总计 8 rounds × (26M + 105M) = 1.04B tokens。
    - **Phase 3: Inference with Pre-Gating**
      推理时：对每个 token sequence (x_1,...,x_T)，先用 router G 一次性计算所有 layer 的 expert 选择（因 router 与 layer index 无关，expert 选择跨 layer 一致）。然后 layer-wise forward：每层仅激活 router 选择的 2 experts + 1 permanent expert。
    - **关键结果**：Read-ME 平均 accuracy 55.5%，超越 Pythia-2.8B (48.3%)、Open-Llama-v2-3.4B (49.3%)、Sheared-Llama-2.7B (53.2%)。MMLU 38.9% vs Sheared-Llama 26.4%（+12.5%）。仅用 1B tokens vs Sheared-Llama 50B tokens。

## PuzzleMoE Efficient Compression of Large Mixture-of-Experts Models via Sparse Expert Merging and Bit-packed inference

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：PuzzleMoE 是一种 training-free MoE 压缩方法，核心包括两部分：(1) **Pairwise Dual-Mask Sparse Expert Merging**——对每对 expert 的权重矩阵 W^i, W^j ∈ R^{d×h}，构造两张互补 mask：Similarity-based mask M^sim = 1_{Δ ≤ τ_sim}（通过 symmetric percent difference Δ = ||W_i|-|W_j|| / (|W_i|+|W_j|) 识别元素级相似的共享权重），Saliency-based mask M_i^sal = 1_{A_i ≥ A_j}（通过 activation-aware saliency A_i = |W_i| ⊙ ||X_i||_2 保留各 expert 的关键权重）。最终 merged weight 为 W_merged = M^sim ⊙ (|W_i|+|W_j|)/2 + (1-M^sim) ⊙ (M_i^sal ⊙ |W_i| + M_j^sal ⊙ |W_j|)。(2) **Bit-packed Encoding**——观察到 Bfloat16 权重的 exponent 范围集中在 112-128（仅需 5 bits），通过 shift 操作将 exponent 映射到 [0,31]，释放出 3 bits 用于嵌入 binary mask 和 sign bit，实现 metadata-free 存储。
  - 实验比较：(1) 与 expert dropping 方法 (NAEE, STUN) 和 expert merging 方法 (D2, HC-SMoE, Sub-MoE) 在 25%/50% sparsity 下对比 zero-shot accuracy（8 benchmarks: WikiText-2 PPL, ARC-c, ARC-e, HellaSwag, PIQA, BoolQ, Winogrande, MMLU）；(2) 与 Wanda 2:4 semi-structured sparsity 对比（仅对 expert 模块剪枝）；(3) Domain-specific reasoning 评估（GSM8K 8-shot, Math-500, AIME24/25）；(4) 压缩效率对比（compression time, memory usage, inference speedup）；(5) 与 quantization 结合（PuzzleMoE 50% sparsity + 3-bit quantization，与 NAEE 25% + 4-bit AWQ 和纯 3-bit AWQ 对比）。

  - 推理评估：Mixtral-8x7B 使用 1-2×NVIDIA A100-80GB GPU；Qwen3-MoE-30B-A3B 使用 1-2×NVIDIA A100-40GB GPU。压缩时间测量：2×A100-80GB GPU。Prefill length=1024, decode length=512。

- 开源情况。基于开源文档和论文，使用例子解释，解释算法pipeline，至少具体到伪代码或张量计算。
  - 开源：https://github.com/Supercomputing-System-AI-Lab/PuzzleMoE
  - 算法 pipeline 张量计算流程：
    - **Phase 1: Dual-Mask Construction（离线压缩）**
      对每对 expert pair (i, j):
      1. 输入 activation 采样：calibration data 传入模型，收集每层各 expert 的输入 activation X_i, X_j ∈ R^{B×h}（仅需一次 forward pass）。
      2. Activation saliency 计算：A_i = |W_i| ⊙ ||X_i||_2, A_j = |W_j| ⊙ ||X_j||_2（沿 batch 维取 L2 norm）。
      3. Similarity mask：Δ = ||W_i| - |W_j|| / (|W_i| + |W_j|)，M^sim[p,q] = 1 若 Δ[p,q] ≤ 0.4，否则 0。
      4. Saliency mask：M_i^sal[p,q] = 1 若 A_i[p,q] ≥ A_j[p,q]，否则 0；M_j^sal = 1 - M_i^sal。
      5. Sparse merging：M_i = M_i^sal ∨ M^sim, M_j = M_j^sal ∨ M^sim。|W_merged| = M^sim ⊙ (|W_i|+|W_j|)/2 + (1-M^sim) ⊙ (M_i^sal ⊙ |W_i| + M_j^sal ⊙ |W_j|)。
      6. Sign 提取：S_i = 1_{W_i < 0}, S_j = 1_{W_j < 0}。
    - **Phase 2: Bit-packing（离线编码）**
      1. Exponent shift：所有 W_merged 中 Bfloat16 exponent < 112 的 round up 到 112，然后全部减 112，将 exponent 映射到 [0,31]（5 bits）。
      2. Pack masks & signs：释放的 3 个 exponent bits 用于存储 M_i/p（expert position 0/1）对应的 2 bits mask + 1 bit sign。
      3. Perplexity 验证：Mixtral-8x7B Wikitext2 PPL before pack=4.37, after pack=4.37；Deepseek-MoE before=6.88, after=6.88。
    - **Phase 3: Inference with CUDA GEMV Decoding Kernel（在线推理）**
      对每个 packed weight W[i,j]：
      1. mask_bit ← (W ≫ (13 - expert_pos)) & 1（提取 mask bit）。
      2. 若 mask_bit == 0：W_decoded ← 0（该位置对此 expert 无效）。
      3. 否则：sign_bit ← (W ≫ (15 - expert_pos)) & 1；exp ← (W & 0x0F80) + (112 ≪ 7)（恢复原始 exponent）；W_decoded ← (sign_bit ≪ 15) | exp | (W & 0x007F)（重构 Bfloat16）。
      4. 执行 GEMV：Output = X @ W_decoded^T。
    - **核心权衡**：τ_sim 控制压缩-精度 trade-off——τ_sim=0 仅保留 saliency mask（等效纯剪枝），τ_sim 过大会过度平均化破坏 expert 差异。τ_sim∈[0.3, 0.5] 最优。

## ProMoE: Fast MoE-based LLM Serving using Proactive Caching

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：ProMoE 的算法层面核心是 **Learned Predictor + GoodPred Metric + Stride Prefetching** 三位一体的预测性 expert 预取算法。(1) **GoodPred Metric**——定义预测器评估指标 GoodPred = Accuracy × FetchRate，其中 Accuracy = 正确预测的 experts 比例，FetchRate = 预测 experts 中能在被访问前完成 prefetch 的比例。GoodPred 同时考虑预测质量和时效性。(2) **Learned Predictor**——二层 MLP（~2M 参数/layer），offline 阶段在 domain dataset 上收集每层 gate function 的 (input, output) pair traces（9:1 train/test split），训练 MLP 学习 layer input → expert selection 的映射。online 阶段每层输入 hidden state → MLP predictor → softmax → Top-K expert indices 作为预测结果。Across models 平均 accuracy 84.7%，远高于 token-based predictor（58.3%）和 skip-based predictor（66.9%-varies）。(3) **Stride Prefetching**——将预测距离加 1（预测 N+1 层而非 N 层），使预测与 prefetch 实现 pipeline 并行。预测在 CPU 执行（~200μs latency），与 GPU LLM 推理完全并行，最大化 FetchRate。stride 带来的 accuracy 下降仅 ~5%。
  - 实验比较：(1) 三种 predictor 的 per-layer accuracy 对比——ProMoE learned predictor vs token-based vs skip-based，在 DS-1 和 QW-2 模型上（Figure 8）；(2) GoodPred 综合评估（accuracy × fetch rate trade-off）；(3) Ablation study 中 prefetch/predictor 各组件的性能贡献。

## PROBE: Co-Balancing Computation and Communication in MoE Inference via Real-Time Predictive Prefetching

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：PROBE 的 Gate-Initialized Lookahead Predictor 是一种预测性算法加速机制。核心设计：(1) 克隆目标 MoE 层的 router 参数 (W_L, b_L) 并冻结作为先验；(2) 附加可训练的轻量残差 MLP——Ŵ_L² σ(Ŵ_L¹ h_{L-1})，其中 σ 为 SiLU 激活，使用零初始化确保初始输出与克隆 router 一致；(3) 输出为预测 logits l̂_L = W_L h_{L-1} + b_L + Ŵ_L² σ(Ŵ_L¹ h_{L-1})；(4) 通过 Scale-Driven Online Distillation 训练——以推理请求流作为混合数据集，最小化 Cross-Entropy loss 使 MLP 输出与 ground-truth router 概率分布对齐。预测结果用于 next-layer expert 分布的提前预估，但不替代实际 dispatch，保证语义等价性。

## Pre-Attention Expert Prediction and Prefetching for Mixture-of-Experts Large Language Models

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？

## Parameters vs FLOPs Scaling Laws for Optimal Sparsity for Mixture-of-Experts Language Models

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：提出将 MoE 稀疏度（Sparsity S）作为显式可控变量纳入 Scaling Law 的算法框架。核心实现包括三部分：(1) 训练不同稀疏度 S ∈ {0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, 90%, 95%, 98%}、不同总参数量 N、不同训练计算预算 C ∈ {3e19, 6e19, 1e20, 3e20, 1e21} FLOPs 的 MoE 语言模型，每个配置均训练至计算最优（compute-optimal）；(2) 对每个固定 C 拟合 IsoFLOP 曲面 L(N,S) = Σa_i(log N)^i + Σb_i(-log(1-S))^i + Σc_i(log N · -log(1-S))^i + d，多项式次数通过网格搜索确定为 (2, 2, 2)（即 N 和 S 的二次函数及交互项），使用 100 次随机子采样交叉验证评估拟合质量；(3) 提出带稀疏度项的参量 Scaling Law 方程 L(N,D,S) = a/N^α + b/D^β + c/(1-S)^λ + d/((1-S)^δ N^γ) + e，使用 L-BFGS 算法和 Huber loss (δ=10^-3) 拟合系数。
  - 实验比较：(1) 固定 C 下，不同 S 对最优 N*（总参数）和 N*_a（活跃参数）的影响——通过 IsoFLOP 曲面沿 N 轴切片分析；(2) 固定 C 和 N 下，不同 S 的 pretraining loss 变化——通过 IsoFLOP 曲面沿 S 轴切片分析最优稀疏度 S*；(3) 不同 C 下(3e19 到 1e21)的 S* vs N 趋势；(4) 不同 S 下，pretraining loss 与下游任务性能（语言理解、世界知识、阅读理解、常识推理四类）的迁移关系；(5) CoT prompting 对 MoE vs Dense 模型推理性能的影响对比（Qwen1.5 系列：0.5B-14B Dense + 5×2.7B MoE）。

## PreMoE: Proactive Inference for Efficient Mixture-of-Experts

- 属于算法pipeline的实现是什么？实验比较什么？
  - 实现：PreMoE 的 Predicted Expert Utility (PEU) 是一种训练无关（training-free）的 MoE Expert 重要性评估与剪枝算法。核心设计分为两阶段：(1) 高置信度过滤——TopK 过滤将候选池缩小为 Top-K_a 个 expert（K_a 匹配模型默认激活数，如 DeepSeek-R1 为 8），然后自适应阈值过滤 r_l = E_x[max_i p_i^l(x)] 逐层计算 local softmax 概率阈值，仅保留概率超过阈值的 expert；(2) Logit 变换——对通过过滤的 logits 应用 f(s) = max(s, sigmoid(s)) 修正负值 logit 的"0-vs-negative"问题（未被选中的 expert 得分为 0 但可能超过有负 logit 的被选 expert）。最终 PEU_i^T = E_{x∈X_T}[s̃_i(x)] 为 expert i 在领域 T 上的平均高置信度变换 logit。基于 PEU ranking 有两种编译策略：Domain-Specific Specialist（每层保留 Top-M PEU expert）和 High-Efficiency Generalist（合成多领域 token-level scores 后计算 multi-domain PEU 再选 Top-M）。全过程不加载完整模型到内存——仅实例化模型骨架并按 PEU pattern 加载选中 expert weights。
  - 实验比较：(1) 三个模型在 specialist 场景对比 Random、Frequency（激活计数）、Act-Logits（仅 TopK 过滤无阈值/logit 变换）、All-Logits（全部 logit 直接平均）、SEER-MoE (Local/Global 变体)、EASY-EP；(2) Generalist 场景对比 Trivial Union baseline；(3) 不同稀疏度 (0%/50%/62.5%/75%) 的 accuracy-efficiency trade-off；(4) PEU ranking validity——Top vs Bottom expert 对比验证排名有效性；(5) 组件消融——逐步叠加 TopK → Threshold Filtering → Logit Transformation；(6) 校准数据效率——1/5/10/50/100 样本 vs 全量对标；(7) Cross-domain generalization——域内专家在域外任务上的性能退化分析。
- 硬件平台是什么，配置是什么。
  - 64×Ascend 910B2-64GB NPU。校准 pattern collection 离线执行于多 NPU 服务器。部署效率（DeepSeek-R1）：0% sparsity (256 experts/layer) → 64 NPUs, latency 115.35 ms/tok, throughput 52.01 tok/s；50% sparsity (128/layer) → 32 NPUs, 93.72 ms/tok, 64.02 tok/s (+23% throughput)；75% sparsity (64/layer) → 16 NPUs, 73.20 ms/tok, 81.97 tok/s (+58% throughput)。
